1.text: Blessed is tha man dat walks not in tha counsel of tha ungodly, nor stands in tha way of sinners, nor sits in tha seat of tha scornful.
But his delight is in tha law of tha LORD; N in his law does he meditate day N night.
N he shall be like a tree planted by tha rivers of water, dat brings forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; N whatever he does shall prosper.
Tha ungodly r not so: but r like tha chaff which tha wind driveth away.
Therefore tha ungodly shall not stand in tha judgment, nor sinners in tha congregation of tha righteous.
4 tha LORD knows tha way of tha righteous: but tha way of tha ungodly shall perish.

2.text: Why do tha heathen rage, N tha people imagine a vain thing?
Tha kings of tha earth set themselves, N tha rulers take counsel together, against tha LORD, N against his anointed, sayin,
Let us break their bands asunder, N cast away their cords from us.
He dat sits in tha heavenz shall laugh: tha Lord shall have ’em in derision.
Then shall he speak 2 ’em in his wrath, N vex ’em in his sore displeasure.
Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
I will declare tha decree: tha LORD has said 2 me, u r my Son; dis day have I begotten u.
Ask of me, N I shall give u tha heathen 4 thine inheritance, N tha uttermost parts of tha earth 4 ur possession.
u will break ’em wit a rod of iron; u will dash ’em in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
Be wise now therefore, O y’all kings: be instructed, y’all judges of tha earth.
Serve tha LORD wit fear, N rejoice wit tremblin.
Kiss tha Son, lest he be angry, N y’all perish from tha way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed r all dey dat put their trust in him.

3.text: LORD, how r dey increased dat trouble me! many r dey dat rise up against me.
Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help 4 him in God. Selah.
But u, O LORD, art a shield 4 me; my glory, N tha lifter up of mine head.
I cried 2 tha LORD wit my voice, N he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
I laid me down N slept; I awaked; 4 tha LORD sustained me.
I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, dat have set themselves against me round about.
Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: 4 u have struck all mine opps upon tha cheek bone; u have broken tha teeth of tha ungodly.
Salvation belongs 2 tha LORD: ur blessing is upon ur people. Selah.

4.text: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: u have enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, N hear my prayer.
O y’all sons of men, how long will y’all turn my glory in2 shame? how long will y’all love vanity, N seek after leasing? Selah.
But know dat tha LORD has set apart him dat is godly 4 himself: tha LORD will hear when I call 2 him.
Stand in awe, N sin not: commune wit ur own heart upon ur bed, N be still. Selah.
Offer tha sacrifices of righteousness, N put ur trust in tha LORD.
There be many dat say, Who will show us any good? LORD, lift u up tha light of ur countenance upon us.
u have put gladness in my heart, more than in tha time dat their corn N their wine increased.
I will both lay me down in peace, N sleep: 4 u, LORD, only make me live in safety.

5.text: Listen up 2 my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
Listen 2 tha voice of my cry, my King, N my God: 4 2 u will I pray.
My voice will u hear in tha morning, O LORD; in tha morning will I direct my prayer 2 u, N will look up.
4 u r not a God dat has pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil live wit u.
Tha foolish shall not stand in ur sight: u hate all workers of iniquity.
u will destroy ’em dat speak leasing: tha LORD will abhor tha bloody N deceitful man.
But as 4 me, I will come in2 ur house in tha crowd of ur mercy: N in ur fear will I worship toward ur holy temple.
Lead me, O LORD, in ur righteousness because of mine opps; make ur way straight before my face.
4 there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; dey flatter wit their tongue.
Destroy u ’em, O God; let ’em fall by their own counsels; cast ’em out in tha crowd of their transgressions; 4 dey have rebelled against u.
But let all dose dat put their trust in u rejoice: let ’em ever shout 4 joy, because u defendest ’em: let ’em also dat love ur name be joyful in u.
4 u, LORD, wilt bless tha righteous; wit favour will u compass him as wit a shield.

6.text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in ur hot displeasure.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; 4 I am weak: O LORD, heal me; 4 my bones r vexed.
My soul is also sore vexed: but u, O LORD, how long?
Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me 4 ur mercies’ sake.
4 in death there is no remembrance of u: in tha grave who shall give u thanks?
I am weary wit my groaning; all tha night make I my bed 2 swim; I water my couch wit my tears.
Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it grows old because of all mine opps.
Depart from me, all y’all workers of iniquity; 4 tha LORD has heard tha voice of my weepin.
Tha LORD has heard my supplication; tha LORD will receive my prayer.
Let all mine opps be ashamed N sore vexed: let ’em return N be ashamed suddenly.

7.text: O LORD my God, in u do I put my trust: save me from all ’em dat persecute me, N deliver me:
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none 2 deliver.
O LORD my God, if I have done dis; if there be iniquity in my hands;
If I have rewarded evil 2 him dat was at peace wit me; (yeah, I have delivered him dat without cause is mine opp:)
Let tha opp persecute my soul, N take it; yeah, let him tread down my life upon tha earth, N lay mine honour in tha dust. Selah.
Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up urself because of tha rage of mine opps: N awake 4 me 2 tha judgment dat u have commanded.
So shall tha congregation of tha people compass u about: 4 their sakes therefore return u on high.
Tha LORD shall judge tha people: judge me, O LORD, according 2 my righteousness, N according 2 mine integrity dat is in me.
Oh let tha wickedness of tha wicked come 2 an end; but establish tha just: 4 tha righteous God trieth tha hearts N reins.
My defence is of God, which saves tha upright in heart.
God judges tha righteous, N God is angry wit tha wicked every day.
If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he has bent his bow, N made it ready.
He has also prepared 4 him tha instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against tha persecutors.
Look, he labors wit iniquity, N has conceived mischief, N brought forth falsehood.
He made a pit, N digged it, N is fallen in2 tha ditch which he made.
His mischief shall return upon his own head, N his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
I will praise tha LORD according 2 his righteousness: N will sing praise 2 tha name of tha LORD most high.

8.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is ur name in all tha earth! who have set ur glory above tha heavenz.
Out of tha mouth of babes N sucklings have u ordained strength because of thine opps, dat u might still tha opp N tha avenger.
When I consider ur heavenz, tha work of ur fingers, tha moon N tha stars, which u have ordained;
What is man, dat u r mindful of him? N tha son of man, dat u visitest him?
4 u have made him a little lower than tha angels, N have crowned him wit glory N honour.
u made him 2 have dominion over tha works of ur hands; u have put all things under his feet:
All sheep N oxen, yeah, N tha beasts of tha field;
Tha fowl of tha air, N tha fish of tha sea, N whatever passes through tha paths of tha seas.
O LORD our Lord, how excellent is ur name in all tha earth!

9.text: I will praise u, O LORD, wit my whole heart; I will show forth all ur marvellous works.
I will be glad N rejoice in u: I will sing praise 2 ur name, O u most High.
When mine opps r turned back, dey shall fall N perish at ur presence.
4 u have maintained my right N my cause; u satest in tha throne judgin right.
u have rebuked tha heathen, u have destroyed tha wicked, u have put out their name 4 ever N ever.
O u opp, destructions r come 2 a perpetual end: N u have destroyed citiez; their memorial is perished wit ’em.
But tha LORD shall endure 4 ever: he has prepared his throne 4 judgment.
N he shall judge tha world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment 2 tha people in uprightness.
Tha LORD also will be a refuge 4 tha oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
N dey dat know ur name will put their trust in u: 4 u, LORD, have not forsaken ’em dat seek u.
Sing praises 2 tha LORD, which lives in Zion: declare among tha people his doings.
When he makes inquisition 4 blood, he remembereth ’em: he forgetteth not tha cry of tha humble.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of ’em dat hate me, u dat lift me up from tha gates of death:
Dat I may show forth all ur praise in tha gates of tha daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in ur salvation.
Tha heathen r sunk down in tha pit dat dey made: in tha net which dey hid is their own foot taken.
Tha LORD is known by tha judgment which he executes: tha wicked is snared in tha work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
Tha wicked shall be turned in2 hell, N all tha nations dat forget God.
4 tha needy shall not alway be forgotten: tha expectation of tha poor shall not perish 4 ever.
Arise, O LORD; don’t let man prevail: let tha heathen be judged in ur sight.
Put ’em in fear, O LORD: dat tha nations may know themselves 2 be but men. Selah.

10.text: Why stand u afar off, O LORD? why hide u urself in times of trouble?
Tha wicked in his pride does persecute tha poor: let ’em be taken in tha devices dat dey have imagined.
4 tha wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, N blesses tha covetous, whom tha LORD abhorreth.
Tha wicked, through tha pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
His ways r always grievous; ur judgments r far above out of his sight: as 4 all his opps, he puffeth at ’em.
He has said in his heart, I shall not be moved: 4 I shall never be in adversity.
His mouth is full of cursing N deceit N fraud: under his tongue is mischief N vanity.
He sits in tha lurking places of tha villages: in tha secret places does he murder tha innocent: his eyes r privily set against tha poor.
He lies in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lies in wait 2 catch tha poor: he does catch tha poor, when he draws him in2 his net.
He croucheth, N humbles himself, dat tha poor may fall by his strong ones.
He has said in his heart, God has forgotten: he hides his face; he will never see it.
Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not tha humble.
So does tha wicked contemn God? he has said in his heart, u will not require it.
u have seen it; 4 u beholdest mischief N spite, 2 requite it wit ur hand: tha poor commits himself 2 u; u r tha helper of tha fatherless.
Break u tha arm of tha wicked N tha evil man: seek out his wickedness till u find none.
Tha LORD is King 4 ever N ever: tha heathen r perished out of his land.
LORD, u have heard tha desire of tha humble: u will prepare their heart, u will cause thine ear 2 hear:
2 judge tha fatherless N tha oppressed, dat tha man of tha earth may no more oppress.

11.text: In tha LORD put I my trust: how say y’all 2 my soul, Flee as a bird 2 ur mountain?
4, look, tha wicked bend their bow, dey make ready their arrow upon tha string, dat dey may privily shoot at tha upright in heart.
If tha foundations be destroyed, what can tha righteous do?
Tha LORD is in his holy temple, tha LORD’s throne is in heaven: his eyes look, his eyelids try, tha children of men.
Tha LORD trieth tha righteous: but tha wicked N him dat loves violence his soul hates.
Upon tha wicked he shall rain snares, fire N brimstone, N an horrible tempest: dis shall be tha portion of their cup.
4 tha righteous LORD loves righteousness; his countenance does look tha upright.

12.text: Help, LORD; 4 tha godly man ceases; 4 tha faithful fail from among tha children of men.
Dey speak vanity every one wit his neighbour: wit flattering lips N wit a double heart do dey speak.
Tha LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, N tha tongue dat speaks proud things:
Who have said, wit our tongue will we prevail; our lips r our own: who is lord over us?
4 tha oppression of tha poor, 4 tha sighing of tha needy, now will I arise, says tha LORD; I will set him in safety from him dat puffeth at him.
Tha words of tha LORD r pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
u will keep ’em, O LORD, u will preserve ’em from dis generation 4 ever.
Tha wicked walk on every side, when tha vilest men r exalted.

13.text: How long will u forget me, O LORD? 4 ever? how long will u hide ur face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, havin sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine opp be exalted over me?
Consider N hear me, O LORD my God: lighten my eyes, lest I sleep tha sleep of death;
Lest mine opp say, I have prevailed against him; N dose dat trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
But I have trusted in ur mercy; my heart shall rejoice in ur salvation.
I will sing 2 tha LORD, because he has dealt bountifully wit me.

14.text: Tha fool has said in his heart, There is no God. dey r corrupt, dey have done abominable works, there is none dat does good.
Tha LORD looked down from heaven upon tha children of men, 2 see if there were any dat did understand, N seek God.
Dey r all gone aside, dey r all together become filthy: there is none dat does good, no, not one.
Have all tha workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as dey eat bread, N call not upon tha LORD.
There were dey in great fear: 4 God is in tha generation of tha righteous.
y’all have shamed tha counsel of tha poor, because tha LORD is his refuge.
Oh dat tha salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when tha LORD brings back tha captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, N Israel shall be glad.

15.text: LORD, who shall abide in ur tabernacle? who shall live in ur holy hill?
He dat walks uprightly, N works righteousness, N speaks tha truth in his heart.
He dat backbiteth not wit his tongue, nor does evil 2 his neighbour, nor takes up a reproach against his neighbour.
In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honors ’em dat fear tha LORD. He dat swears 2 his own hurt, N changeth not.
He dat puts not out his money 2 usury, nor takes reward against tha innocent. He dat does dese things shall never be moved.

16.text: Preserve me, O God: 4 in u do I put my trust.
O my soul, u have said 2 tha LORD, u r my Lord: my goodness extendeth not 2 u;
But 2 tha saints dat r in tha earth, N 2 tha excellent, in whom is all my delight.
Their sorrows shall be multiplied dat hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their namez in2 my lips.
Tha LORD is tha portion of mine inheritance N of my cup: u maintainest my lot.
Tha lines r fallen 2 me in pleasant places; yeah, I have a goodly heritage.
I will bless tha LORD, who has given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in tha night seasons.
I have set tha LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Therefore my heart is glad, N my glory rejoices: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
4 u will not leave my soul in hell; neither will u suffer thine Holy One 2 see corruption.
u will show me tha path of life: in ur presence is fulness of joy; at ur right hand there r pleasures 4 evermore.

17.text: Hear tha right, O LORD, attend 2 my cry, listen up 2 my prayer, dat goes not out of feigned lips.
Let my sentence come forth from ur presence; let ur eyes look tha things dat r equal.
u have proved mine heart; u have visited me in tha night; u have tried me, N will find nothing; I am purposed dat my mouth shall not transgress.
Concerning tha works of men, by tha word of ur lips I have kept me from tha paths of tha destroyer.
Hold up my goings in ur paths, dat my footsteps slip not.
I have called upon u, 4 u will hear me, O God: incline thine ear 2 me, N hear my speech.
Show ur marvellous lovingkindness, O u dat save by ur right hand ’em which put their trust in u from dose dat rise up against ’em.
Keep me as tha apple of tha eye, hide me under tha shadow of ur wings,
From tha wicked dat oppress me, from my deadly opps, who compass me about.
Dey r inclosed in their own fat: wit their mouth dey speak proudly.
Dey have now compassed us in our steps: dey have set their eyes bowin down 2 tha earth;
Like as a lion dat is greedy of his prey, N as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from tha wicked, which is ur sword:

From men which r ur hand, O LORD, from men of tha world, which have their portion in dis life, N whose belly u fill wit ur hid treasure: dey r full of children, N leave tha rest of their substance 2 their babes.
As 4 me, I will look ur face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, wit ur likeness.

18.text: I will love u, O LORD, my strength.
Tha LORD is my rock, N my fortress, N my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, N tha horn of my salvation, N my high tower.
I will call upon tha LORD, who is worthy 2 be praised: so shall I be saved from mine opps.
Tha sorrows of death compassed me, N tha floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
Tha sorrows of hell compassed me about: tha snares of death prevented me.
In my distress I called upon tha LORD, N cried 2 my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, N my cry came before him, even in2 his ears.
Then tha earth shook N trembled; tha foundations also of tha hills moved N were shaken, because he was angry.
There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, N fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
He bowed tha heavenz also, N came down: N darkness was under his feet.
N he rode upon a cherub, N did fly: yeah, he did fly upon tha wings of tha wind.
He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waterz N thick clouds of tha skies.
At tha brightness dat was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones N coals of fire.
Tha LORD also thundered in tha heavenz, N tha Highest gave his voice; hail stones N coals of fire.
Yeah, he sent out his arrows, N scattered ’em; N he shot out lightnings, N discomfited ’em.
Then tha channels of waterz were seen, N tha foundations of tha world were discovered at ur rebuke, O LORD, at tha blast of tha breath of ur nostrils.
He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waterz.
He delivered me from my strong opp, N from ’em which hated me: 4 dey were too strong 4 me.
Dey prevented me in tha day of my calamity: but tha LORD was my stay.
He brought me forth also in2 a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
Tha LORD rewarded me according 2 my righteousness; according 2 tha cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
4 I have kept tha ways of tha LORD, N have not wickedly departed from my God.
4 all his judgments were before me, N I did not put away his statutes from me.
I was also upright before him, N I kept myself from mine iniquity.
Therefore has tha LORD recompensed me according 2 my righteousness, according 2 tha cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
Wit tha merciful u will show urself merciful; wit an upright man u will show urself upright;
Wit tha pure u will show urself pure; N wit tha froward u will show urself froward.
4 u will save tha afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
4 u will light my candle: tha LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
4 by u I have run through a troop; N by my God have I leaped over a wall.
As 4 God, his way is perfect: tha word of tha LORD is tried: he is a buckler 2 all dose dat trust in him.
4 who is God save tha LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
It is God dat girdeth me wit strength, N makes my way perfect.
He makes my feet like hinds’ feet, N sets me upon my high places.
He teaches my hands 2 war, so dat a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
u have also given me tha shield of ur salvation: N ur right hand has holden me up, N ur gentleness has made me great.
u have enlarged my steps under me, dat my feet did not slip.
I have pursued mine opps, N overtaken ’em: neither did I turn again till dey were consumed.
I have wounded ’em dat dey were not able 2 rise: dey r fallen under my feet.
4 u have girded me wit strength 2 tha battle: u have subdued under me dose dat rose up against me.
u have also given me tha necks of mine opps; dat I might destroy ’em dat hate me.
Dey cried, but there was none 2 save ’em: even 2 tha LORD, but he answered ’em not.
Then did I beat ’em small as tha dust before tha wind: I did cast ’em out as tha dirt in tha streets.
u have delivered me from tha strivings of tha people; N u have made me tha head of tha heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
As soon as dey hear of me, dey shall obey me: tha strangers shall submit themselves 2 me.
Tha strangers shall fade away, N be afraid out of their close places.
Tha LORD lives; N blessed be my rock; N let tha God of my salvation be exalted.
It is God dat avengeth me, N subdueth tha people under me.
He delivers me from mine opps: yeah, u lift me up above dose dat rise up against me: u have delivered me from tha violent man.
Therefore will I give thanks 2 u, O LORD, among tha heathen, N sing praises 2 ur name.
Great deliverance gives he 2 his king; N shows mercy 2 his anointed, 2 David, N 2 his seed 4 evermore.

19.text: Tha heavenz declare tha glory of God; N tha firmament shows his handywork.
Day 2 day utters speech, N night 2 night shows knowledge.
There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
Their line is gone out through all tha earth, N their words 2 tha end of tha world. In ’em has he set a tabernacle 4 tha sun,
Which is as a bridegroom comin out of his chamber, N rejoices as a strong man 2 run a race.
His goin forth is from tha end of tha heaven, N his circuit 2 tha ends of it: N there is nothing hid from tha heat of it.
Tha law of tha LORD is perfect, converting tha soul: tha testimony of tha LORD is sure, makin wise tha simple.
Tha statutes of tha LORD r right, rejoicin tha heart: tha commandment of tha LORD is pure, enlightening tha eyes.
Tha fear of tha LORD is clean, endurin 4 ever: tha judgments of tha LORD r true N righteous altogether.
More 2 be desired r dey than gold, yeah, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey N tha honeycomb.
Moreover by ’em is ur servant warned: N in keepin of ’em there is great reward.
Who can understand his errors? cleanse u me from secret faults.
Keep back ur servant also from presumptuous sins; let ’em not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, N I shall be innocent from tha great transgression.
Let tha words of my mouth, N tha meditation of my heart, be acceptable in ur sight, O LORD, my strength, N my redeemer.

20.text: Tha LORD hear u in tha day of trouble; tha name of tha God of Jacob defend u;
Send u help from tha sanctuary, N strengthen u out of Zion;
Remember all ur offerings, N accept ur burnt sacrifice; Selah.
Grant u according 2 ur own heart, N fulfil all ur counsel.
We will rejoice in ur salvation, N in tha name of our God we will set up our banners: tha LORD fulfil all ur petitions.
Now know I dat tha LORD saves his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven wit tha saving strength of his right hand.
Some trust in chariots, N some in horses: but we will remember tha name of tha LORD our God.
Dey r brought down N fallen: but we r risen, N stand upright.
Save, LORD: let tha king hear us when we call.

21.text: Tha king shall joy in ur strength, O LORD; N in ur salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
u have given him his heart’s desire, N have not withholden tha request of his lips. Selah.
4 u preventest him wit tha blessings of goodness: u set a crown of pure gold on his head.
He asked life of u, N u gave it him, even length of days 4 ever N ever.
His glory is great in ur salvation: honour N majesty have u laid upon him.
4 u have made him most blessed 4 ever: u have made him exceeding glad wit ur countenance.
4 tha king trusts in tha LORD, N through tha mercy of tha most High he shall not be moved.
Thine hand shall find out all thine opps: ur right hand shall find out dose dat hate u.
u will make ’em as a fiery oven in tha time of thine anger: tha LORD shall swallow ’em up in his wrath, N tha fire shall devour ’em.
Their fruit will u destroy from tha earth, N their seed from among tha children of men.
4 dey intended evil against u: dey imagined a mischievous device, which dey r not able 2 perform.
Therefore will u make ’em turn their back, when u will make ready thine arrows upon ur strings against tha face of ’em.
Be u exalted, LORD, in ur own strength: so will we sing N praise ur power.

22.text: My God, my God, why have u forsaken me? why r u so far from helping me, N from tha words of my roaring?
O my God, I cry in tha daytime, but u hear not; N in tha night season, N am not silent.
But u r holy, O u dat inhabitest tha praises of Israel.
Our fathers trusted in u: dey trusted, N u did deliver ’em.
Dey cried 2 u, N were delivered: dey trusted in u, N were not confounded.
But I am a worm, N no man; a reproach of men, N despised of tha people.
All dey dat see me laugh me 2 scorn: dey shoot out tha lip, dey shake tha head, sayin,
He trusted on tha LORD dat he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seein he delighted in him.
But u r he dat took me out of tha womb: u did make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.
I was cast upon u from tha womb: u r my God from my mother’s belly.
Don’t be far from me; 4 trouble is near; 4 there is none 2 help.
Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
Dey gaped upon me wit their mouths, as a ravening N a roaring lion.
I am poured out like water, N all my bones r out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in tha midst of my bowels.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd; N my tongue clings 2 my jaws; N u have brought me in2 tha dust of death.
4 dogs have compassed me: tha assembly of tha wicked have inclosed me: dey pierced my hands N my feet.
I may tell all my bones: dey look N stare upon me.
Dey part my garments among ’em, N cast lots upon my vesture.
But don’t be u far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste u 2 help me.
Deliver my soul from tha sword; my darling from tha power of tha dog.
Save me from tha lion’s mouth: 4 u have heard me from tha horns of tha unicorns.
I will declare ur name 2 my brothers: in tha midst of tha congregation will I praise u.
y’all dat fear tha LORD, praise him; all y’all tha seed of Jacob, glorify him; N fear him, all y’all tha seed of Israel.
4 he has not despised nor abhorred tha affliction of tha afflicted; neither has he hid his face from him; but when he cried 2 him, he heard.
My praise shall be of u in tha great congregation: I will pay my vows before ’em dat fear him.
Tha meek shall eat N be satisfied: dey shall praise tha LORD dat seek him: ur heart shall live 4 ever.
All tha ends of tha world shall remember N turn 2 tha LORD: N all tha kindreds of tha nations shall worship before u.
4 tha kingdom is tha LORD’s: N he is tha governor among tha nations.
All dey dat be fat upon earth shall eat N worship: all dey dat go down 2 tha dust shall bow before him: N none can keep alive his own soul.
A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted 2 tha Lord 4 a generation.

4 innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so dat I am not able 2 look up; dey r more than tha hairs of mine head: therefore my heart fails me.
Be pleased, O LORD, 2 deliver me: O LORD, make haste 2 help me.
Let ’em be ashamed N confounded together dat seek after my soul 2 destroy it; let ’em be driven backward N put 2 shame dat wish me evil.
Let ’em be desolate 4 a reward of their shame dat say 2 me, Aha, aha.
Let all dose dat seek u rejoice N be glad in u: let such as love ur salvation say continually, tha LORD be magnified.
But I am poor N needy; yet tha Lord thinks upon me: u r my help N my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

41.text: Blessed is he dat considers tha poor: tha LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
Tha LORD will preserve him, N keep him alive; N he shall be blessed upon tha earth: N u will not deliver him 2 tha will of his opps.
Tha LORD will strengthen him upon tha bed of languishing: u will make all his bed in his sickness.
I said, LORD, be merciful 2 me: heal my soul; 4 I have sinned against u.
Mine opps speak evil of me, When shall he die, N his name perish?
N if he come 2 see me, he speaks vanity: his heart gathers iniquity 2 itself; when he goes abroad, he tells it.
All dat hate me whisper together against me: against me do dey devise my hurt.
An evil disease, say dey, clings fast 2 him: N now dat he lies he shall rise up no more.
Yeah, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
But u, O LORD, be merciful 2 me, N raise me up, dat I may requite ’em.
By dis I know dat u favourest me, because mine opp does not triumph over me.
N as 4 me, u upholdest me in mine integrity, N set me before ur face 4 ever.
Blessed be tha LORD God of Israel from everlasting, N 2 everlasting. Amen, N Amen.

42.text: As tha hart panteth after tha water brooks, so panteth my soul after u, O God.
My soul thirsteth 4 God, 4 tha livin God: when shall I come N appear before God?
My tears have been my food day N night, while dey continually say 2 me, Where is ur God?
When I remember dese things, I pour out my soul in me: 4 I had gone wit tha crowd, I went wit ’em 2 tha house of God, wit tha voice of joy N praise, wit a crowd dat kept holyday.
Why r u cast down, O my soul? N why r u disquieted in me? hope u in God: 4 I shall yet praise him 4 tha help of his countenance.
O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember u from tha land of Jordan, N of tha Hermonites, from tha hill Mizar.
Deep calls 2 deep at tha noise of ur waterspouts: all ur waves N ur billows r gone over me.
Yet tha LORD will command his lovingkindness in tha daytime, N in tha night his song shall be wit me, N my prayer 2 tha God of my life.
I will say 2 God my rock, Why have u forgotten me? why go I mournin because of tha oppression of tha opp?
As wit a sword in my bones, mine opps reproach me; while dey say daily 2 me, Where is ur God?
Why r u cast down, O my soul? N why r u disquieted within me? hope u in God: 4 I shall yet praise him, who is tha health of my countenance, N my God.

43.text: Judge me, O God, N plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from tha deceitful N unjust man.
4 u r tha God of my strength: why do u cast me off? why go I mournin because of tha oppression of tha opp?
O send out ur light N ur truth: let ’em lead me; let ’em bring me 2 ur holy hill, N 2 ur tabernacles.
Then will I go 2 tha altar of God, 2 God my exceeding joy: yeah, upon tha harp will I praise u, O God my God.
Why r u cast down, O my soul? N why r u disquieted within me? hope in God: 4 I shall yet praise him, who is tha health of my countenance, N my God.

44.text: We have heard wit our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work u did in their days, in tha times of old.
How u did drive out tha heathen wit ur hand, N plantedst ’em; how u did afflict tha people, N cast ’em out.
4 dey got not tha land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save ’em: but ur right hand, N thine arm, N tha light of ur countenance, because u had a favour 2 ’em.
u r my King, O God: command deliverances 4 Jacob.
Through u will we push down our opps: through ur name will we tread ’em under dat rise up against us.
4 I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
But u have saved us from our opps, N have put ’em 2 shame dat hated us.
In God we boast all tha day long, N praise ur name 4 ever. Selah.
But u have cast off, N put us 2 shame; N go not forth wit our armies.
u make us 2 turn back from tha opp: N dey which hate us spoil 4 themselves.
u have given us like sheep appointed 4 food; N have scattered us among tha heathen.
u sell ur people 4 nothing, N do not increase ur wealth by their price.
u make us a reproach 2 our neighbours, a scorn N a derision 2 ’em dat r round about us.
u make us a byword among tha heathen, a shaking of tha head among tha people.
My confusion is continually before me, N tha shame of my face has covered me,
4 tha voice of him dat reproaches N blasphemeth; by reason of tha opp N avenger.
All dis is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten u, neither have we dealt falsely in ur covenant.
Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from ur way;
Though u have sore broken us in tha place of dragons, N covered us wit tha shadow of death.
If we have forgotten tha name of our God, or stretched out our hands 2 a strange god;
Shall not God search dis out? 4 he knows tha secrets of tha heart.
Yeah, 4 ur sake r we killed all tha day long; we r counted as sheep 4 tha slaughter.
Awake, why sleep u, O Lord? arise, cast us not off 4 ever.
So hide u ur face, N forgettest our affliction N our oppression?
4 our soul is bowed down 2 tha dust: our belly clings 2 tha earth.
Arise 4 our help, N redeem us 4 ur mercies’ sake.

45.text: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of tha things which I have made touching tha king: my tongue is tha pen of a ready writer.
u r fairer than tha children of men: grace is poured in2 ur lips: therefore God has blessed u 4 ever.
Gird ur sword upon ur thigh, O most mighty, wit ur glory N ur majesty.
N in ur majesty ride prosperously because of truth N meekness N righteousness; N ur right hand shall teach u terrible things.
Thine arrows r sharp in tha heart of tha king’s opps; whereby tha people fall under u.
Ur throne, O God, is 4 ever N ever: tha sceptre of ur kingdom is a right sceptre.
u love righteousness, N hate wickedness: therefore God, ur God, has anointed u wit tha oil of gladness above ur fellows.
All ur garments smell of myrrh, N aloes, N cassia, out of tha ivory palaces, whereby dey have made u glad.
Kings’ daughters were among ur honourable women: upon ur right hand did stand tha queen in gold of Ophir.
Listen, O daughter, N consider, N incline thine ear; forget also ur own people, N ur father’s house;
So shall tha king greatly desire ur beauty: 4 he is ur Lord; N worship u him.
N tha daughter of Tyre shall be there wit a gift; even tha rich among tha people shall intreat ur favour.
Tha king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
She shall be brought 2 tha king in clothing of needlework: tha virgins her companions dat follow her shall be brought 2 u.
Wit gladness N rejoicin shall dey be brought: dey shall enter in2 tha king’s palace.
Instead of ur fathers shall be ur children, whom u may make princes in all tha earth.
I will make ur name 2 be remembered in all generations: therefore shall tha people praise u 4 ever N ever.

46.text: God is our refuge N strength, a very present help in trouble.
Therefore will not we fear, though tha earth be removed, N though tha mountains be carried in2 tha midst of tha sea;
Though tha waterz of it roar N be troubled, though tha mountains shake wit tha swelling of it. Selah.
There is a river, tha streams whereof shall make glad tha city of God, tha holy place of tha tabernacles of tha most High.
God is in tha midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, N dat right early.
Tha heathen raged, tha kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, tha earth melted.
Tha LORD of hosts is wit us; tha God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
Come, look tha works of tha LORD, what desolations he has made in tha earth.
He makes wars 2 cease 2 tha end of tha earth; he breaks tha bow, N cuts tha spear in sunder; he burns tha chariot in tha fire.
Be still, N know dat I am God: I will be exalted among tha heathen, I will be exalted in tha earth.
Tha LORD of hosts is wit us; tha God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

47.text: O clap ur hands, all y’all people; shout 2 God wit tha voice of triumph.
4 tha LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all tha earth.
He shall subdue tha people under us, N tha nations under our feet.
He shall choose our inheritance 4 us, tha excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
God is gone up wit a shout, tha LORD wit tha sound of a trumpet.
Sing praises 2 God, sing praises: sing praises 2 our King, sing praises.
4 God is tha King of all tha earth: sing y’all praises wit understanding.
God reigns over tha heathen: God sits upon tha throne of his holiness.
Tha princes of tha people r gathered together, even tha people of tha God of Abraham: 4 tha shields of tha earth belong 2 God: he is greatly exalted.

48.text: Great is tha LORD, N greatly 2 be praised in tha city of our God, in tha mountain of his holiness.
Beautiful 4 situation, tha joy of tha whole earth, is mount Zion, on tha sides of tha north, tha city of tha great King.
God is known in her palaces 4 a refuge.
4, look, tha kings were assembled, dey passed by together.
Dey saw it, N so dey marvelled; dey were troubled, N hasted away.
Fear took hold upon ’em there, N pain, as of a woman in travail.
u break tha ships of Tarshish wit an east wind.
As we have heard, so have we seen in tha city of tha LORD of hosts, in tha city of our God: God will establish it 4 ever. Selah.
We have thought of ur lovingkindness, O God, in tha midst of ur temple.
According 2 ur name, O God, so is ur praise 2 tha ends of tha earth: ur right hand is full of righteousness.
Let mount Zion rejoice, let tha daughters of Judah be glad, because of ur judgments.
Walk about Zion, N go round about her: tell tha towers of it.
Mark y’all well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; dat y’all may tell it 2 tha generation followin.
4 dis God is our God 4 ever N ever: he will be our guide even 2 death.

49.text: Hear dis, all y’all people; listen up, all y’all inhabitants of tha world:
Both low N high, rich N poor, together.
My mouth shall speak of wisdom; N tha meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
I will incline mine ear 2 a parable: I will open my dark sayin upon tha harp.
So should I fear in tha days of evil, when tha iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
Dey dat trust in their wealth, N boast themselves in tha crowd of their riches;
None of ’em can by any means redeem his brother, nor give 2 God a ransom 4 him:
(4 tha redemption of their soul is precious, N it ceases 4 ever:)
Dat he should still live 4 ever, N not see corruption.
4 he sees dat wise men die, likewise tha fool N tha brutish person perish, N leave their wealth 2 others.
Their inward thought is, dat their houses shall continue 4 ever, N their livin places 2 all generations; dey call their lands after their own namez.
Nevertheless man bein in honour abides not: he is like tha beasts dat perish.
Dis their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
Like sheep dey r laid in tha grave; death shall feed on ’em; N tha upright shall have dominion over ’em in tha morning; N their beauty shall consume in tha grave from their livin.
But God will redeem my soul from tha power of tha grave: 4 he shall receive me. Selah.
Don’t be u afraid when one is made rich, when tha glory of his house is increased;
4 when he dies he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
Though while he lived he blessed his soul: N men will praise u, when u do well 2 urself.
He shall go 2 tha generation of his fathers; dey shall never see light.
Man dat is in honour, N understands not, is like tha beasts dat perish.

50.text: Tha mighty God, even tha LORD, has spoken, N called tha earth from tha risin of tha sun 2 tha goin down of it.

N tha heavenz shall declare his righteousness: 4 God is judge himself. Selah.
Hear, O my people, N I will speak; O Israel, N I will testify against u: I am God, even ur God.

4 every beast of tha forest is mine, N tha cattle upon a thousand hills.
I know all tha fowls of tha mountains: N tha wild beasts of tha field r mine.
If I were hungry, I would not tell u: 4 tha world is mine, N tha fulness of it.
Will I eat tha flesh of bulls, or drink tha blood of goats?
Offer 2 God thanksgiving; N pay ur vows 2 tha most High:
N call upon me in tha day of trouble: I will deliver u, N u will glorify me.
But 2 tha wicked God says, What have u 2 do 2 declare my statutes, or dat u should take my covenant in ur mouth?
Seein u hate instruction, N cast my words behind u.
When u saw a thief, then u consentedst wit him, N have been partaker wit adulterers.
u give ur mouth 2 evil, N ur tongue frameth deceit.
u sit N speak against ur brother; u slanderest ur own mother’s son.

Whoever offers praise glorifieth me: N 2 him dat ordereth his conversation aright will I show tha salvation of God.

51.text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according 2 ur lovingkindness: according 2 tha crowd of ur tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

4 I acknowledge my transgressions: N my sin is ever before me.
Against u, u only, have I sinned, N done dis evil in ur sight: dat u might be justified when u speak, N be clear when u judge.

4 u desire not sacrifice; else would I give it: u delight not in burnt offering.
Tha sacrifices of God r a broken spirit: a broken N a contrite heart, O God, u will not despise.

Then will u be pleased wit tha sacrifices of righteousness, wit burnt offering N whole burnt offering: then shall dey offer bullocks upon thine altar.

52.text: Why boastest u urself in mischief, O mighty man? tha goodness of God endures continually.

u love all devouring words, O u deceitful tongue.
God shall likewise destroy u 4 ever, he shall take u away, N pluck u out of ur livin place, N root u out of tha land of tha livin. Selah.

53.text: Tha fool has said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt r dey, N have done abominable iniquity: there is none dat does good.

Every one of ’em is gone back: dey r altogether become filthy; there is none dat does good, no, not one.

There were dey in great fear, where no fear was: 4 God has scattered tha bones of him dat encampeth against u: u have put ’em 2 shame, because God has despised ’em.

4 strangers r risen up against me, N oppressors seek after my soul: dey have not set God before ’em. Selah.

55.text: Listen up 2 my prayer, O God; N hide not urself from my supplication.

N I said, Oh dat I had wings like a dove! 4 then would I fly away, N be at rest.

Day N night dey go about it upon tha walls of it: mischief also N sorrow r in tha midst of it.
Wickedness is in tha midst of it: deceit N guile depart not from her streets.
4 it was not an opp dat reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he dat hated me dat did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
But it was u, a man mine equal, my guide, N mine acquaintance.

Let death seize upon ’em, N let ’em go down quick in2 hell: 4 wickedness is in their dwellings, N among ’em.

But u, O God, will bring ’em down in2 tha pit of destruction: bloody N deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in u.

56.text: Be merciful 2 me, O God: 4 man would swallow me up; he fightin daily oppresseth me.
Mine opps would daily swallow me up: 4 dey be many dat fight against me, O u most High.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in u.

Every day dey wrest my words: all their thoughts r against me 4 evil.
Dey gather themselves together, dey hide themselves, dey mark my steps, when dey wait 4 my soul.

u tell my wanderings: put u my tears in2 ur bottle: r dey not in ur book?

Ur vows r upon me, O God: I will render praises 2 u.
4 u have delivered my soul from death: wilt not u deliver my feet from fallin, dat I may walk before God in tha light of tha livin?

Dey have prepared a net 4 my steps; my soul is bowed down: dey have digged a pit before me, in2 tha midst whereof dey r fallen themselves. Selah.

I will praise u, O Lord, among tha people: I will sing 2 u among tha nations.
4 ur mercy is great 2 tha heavenz, N ur truth 2 tha clouds.
Be u exalted, O God, above tha heavenz: let ur glory be above all tha earth.

58.text: Do y’all indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do y’all judge uprightly, O y’all sons of men?

Tha wicked r estranged from tha womb: dey go astray as soon as dey be born, speakin lies.

59.text: Deliver me from mine opps, O my God: defend me from ’em dat rise up against me.
Deliver me from tha workers of iniquity, N save me from bloody men.
4, look, dey lie in wait 4 my soul: tha mighty r gathered against me; not 4 my transgression, nor 4 my sin, O LORD.
Dey run N prepare themselves without my fault: awake 2 help me, N look.
u therefore, O LORD God of hosts, tha God of Israel, awake 2 visit all tha heathen: don’t be merciful 2 any wicked transgressors. Selah.
Dey return at evening: dey make a noise like a dog, N go round about tha city.
Look, dey belch out wit their mouth: swords r in their lips: 4 who, say dey, does hear?
But u, O LORD, will laugh at ’em; u will have all tha heathen in derision.

Tha God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine opps.

4 tha sin of their mouth N tha words of their lips let ’em even be taken in their pride: N 4 cursing N lyin which dey speak.

N at evening let ’em return; N let ’em make a noise like a dog, N go round about tha city.
Let ’em wander up N down 4 food, N grudge if dey don’t be satisfied.
But I will sing of ur power; yeah, I will sing aloud of ur mercy in tha morning: 4 u have been my defence N refuge in tha day of my trouble.
2 u, O my strength, will I sing: 4 God is my defence, N tha God of my mercy.

60.text: O God, u have cast us off, u have scattered us, u have been displeased; O turn urself 2 us again.
u have made tha earth 2 tremble; u have broken it: heal tha breaches of it; 4 it shakes.
u have showed ur people hard things: u have made us 2 drink tha wine of astonishment.
u have given a banner 2 ’em dat fear u, dat it may be displayed because of tha truth. Selah.
Dat ur beloved may be delivered; save wit ur right hand, N hear me.
God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, N mete out tha valley of Succoth.

Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph u because of me.

4 u have been a shelter 4 me, N a strong tower from tha opp.

62.text: Truly my soul waits upon God: from him comes my salvation.

Dey only consult 2 cast him down from his excellency: dey delight in lies: dey bless wit their mouth, but dey curse inwardly. Selah.
My soul, wait u only upon God; 4 my expectation is from him.
He only is my rock N my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
In God is my salvation N my glory: tha rock of my strength, N my refuge, is in God.
Trust in him at all times; y’all people, pour out ur heart before him: God is a refuge 4 us. Selah.
Surely men of low degree r vanity, N men of high degree r a lie: 2 be laid in tha balance, dey r altogether lighter than vanity.
Trust not in oppression, N become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not ur heart upon ’em.
God has spoken once; twice have I heard dis; dat power belongs 2 God.
Also 2 u, O Lord, belongs mercy: 4 u renderest 2 every man according 2 his work.

63.text: O God, u r my God; early will I seek u: my soul thirsteth 4 u, my flesh longeth 4 u in a dry N thirsty land, where no water is;
2 see ur power N ur glory, so as I have seen u in tha sanctuary.
Because ur lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise u.
Like dis will I bless u while I live: I will lift up my hands in ur name.
My soul shall be satisfied as wit marrow N fatness; N my mouth shall praise u wit joyful lips:
When I remember u upon my bed, N meditate on u in tha night watches.
Because u have been my help, therefore in tha shadow of ur wings will I rejoice.
My soul follows hard after u: ur right hand upholdeth me.
But dose dat seek my soul, 2 destroy it, shall go in2 tha lower parts of tha earth.
Dey shall fall by tha sword: dey shall be a portion 4 foxes.
But tha king shall rejoice in God; every one dat swears by him shall glory: but tha mouth of ’em dat speak lies shall be stopped.

64.text: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of tha opp.
Hide me from tha secret counsel of tha wicked; from tha insurrection of tha workers of iniquity:
Who whet their tongue like a sword, N bend their bows 2 shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
Dat dey may shoot in secret at tha perfect: suddenly do dey shoot at him, N don’t fear.
Dey encourage themselves in an evil matter: dey commune of laying snares privily; dey say, Who shall see ’em?
Dey search out iniquities; dey accomplish a diligent search: both tha inward thought of every one of ’em, N tha heart, is deep.
But God shall shoot at ’em wit an arrow; suddenly shall dey be wounded.
So dey shall make their own tongue 2 fall upon themselves: all dat see ’em shall flee away.
N all men shall fear, N shall declare tha work of God; 4 dey shall wisely consider of his doin.
Tha righteous shall be glad in tha LORD, N shall trust in him; N all tha upright in heart shall glory.

65.text: Praise waits 4 u, O God, in Sion: N 2 u shall tha vow be performed.
O u dat hear prayer, 2 u shall all flesh come.
Iniquities prevail against me: as 4 our transgressions, u will purge ’em away.
Blessed is tha man whom u choosest, N cause 2 approach 2 u, dat he may live in ur courts: we shall be satisfied wit tha goodness of ur house, even of ur holy temple.
By terrible things in righteousness will u answer us, O God of our salvation; who art tha confidence of all tha ends of tha earth, N of ’em dat r afar off upon tha sea:
Which by his strength sets fast tha mountains; bein girded wit power:
Which stilleth tha noise of tha seas, tha noise of their waves, N tha tumult of tha people.
Dey also dat live in tha uttermost parts r afraid at ur tokens: u make tha outgoings of tha morning N evening 2 rejoice.
u visitest tha earth, N waterest it: u greatly enrichest it wit tha river of God, which is full of water: u preparest ’em corn, when u have so provided 4 it.
u waterest tha ridges of it abundantly: u settlest tha furrows of it: u make it soft wit showers: u bless tha springing of it.
u crownest tha year wit ur goodness; N ur paths drop fatness.
Dey drop upon tha pastures of tha wilderness: N tha little hills rejoice on every side.
Tha pastures r clothed wit flocks; tha valleys also r covered over wit corn; dey shout 4 joy, dey also sing.

66.text: Make a joyful noise 2 God, all y’all lands:
Sing forth tha honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
Say 2 God, How terrible r u in ur works! through tha greatness of ur power shall thine opps submit themselves 2 u.
All tha earth shall worship u, N shall sing 2 u; dey shall sing 2 ur name. Selah.
Come N see tha works of God: he is terrible in his doin toward tha children of men.
He turned tha sea in2 dry land: dey went through tha flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
He rules by his power 4 ever; his eyes look tha nations: don’t let tha rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
O bless our God, y’all people, N make tha voice of his praise 2 be heard:
Which holds our soul in life, N suffereth not our feet 2 be moved.
4 u, O God, have proved us: u have tried us, as silver is tried.
u brought us in2 tha net; u laidst affliction upon our loins.
u have caused men 2 ride over our heads; we went through fire N through water: but u brought us out in2 a wealthy place.
I will go in2 ur house wit burnt offerings: I will pay u my vows,
Which my lips have uttered, N my mouth has spoken, when I was in trouble.
I will offer 2 u burnt sacrifices of fatlings, wit tha incense of rams; I will offer bullocks wit goats. Selah.
Come N hear, all y’all dat fear God, N I will declare what he has done 4 my soul.
I cried 2 him wit my mouth, N he was extolled wit my tongue.
If I regard iniquity in my heart, tha Lord will not hear me:
But for real God has heard me; he has attended 2 tha voice of my prayer.
Blessed be God, which has not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

67.text: God be merciful 2 us, N bless us; N cause his face 2 shine upon us; Selah.
Dat ur way may be known upon earth, ur saving health among all nations.
Let tha people praise u, O God; let all tha people praise u.
O let tha nations be glad N sing 4 joy: 4 u will judge tha people righteously, N govern tha nations upon earth. Selah.
Let tha people praise u, O God; let all tha people praise u.
Then shall tha earth yield her increase; N God, even our own God, shall bless us.
God shall bless us; N all tha ends of tha earth shall fear him.

68.text: Let God arise, let his opps be scattered: let ’em also dat hate him flee before him.
As smoke is driven away, so drive ’em away: as wax melts before tha fire, so let tha wicked perish at tha presence of God.
But let tha righteous be glad; let ’em rejoice before God: yeah, let ’em exceedingly rejoice.
Sing 2 God, sing praises 2 his name: extol him dat rides upon tha heavenz by his name Jah, N rejoice before him.
A father of tha fatherless, N a judge of tha widows, is God in his holy habitation.
God sets tha solitary in families: he brings out dose which r bound wit chains: but tha rebellious live in a dry land.
O God, when u went forth before ur people, when u did march through tha wilderness; Selah:
Tha earth shook, tha heavenz also dropped at tha presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at tha presence of God, tha God of Israel.
u, O God, did send a plentiful rain, whereby u did confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
Ur congregation has lived in it: u, O God, have prepared of ur goodness 4 tha poor.
Tha Lord gave tha word: great was tha company of dose dat published it.
Kings of armies did flee apace: N she dat tarried at home divided tha spoil.
Though y’all have lien among tha pots, yet shall y’all be as tha wings of a dove covered wit silver, N her feathers wit yellow gold.
When tha Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
Tha hill of God is as tha hill of Bashan; an high hill as tha hill of Bashan.
Why leap y’all, y’all high hills? dis is tha hill which God desires 2 live in; yeah, tha LORD will live in it 4 ever.
Tha chariots of God r twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: tha Lord is among ’em, as in Sinai, in tha holy place.
u have ascended on high, u have led captivity captive: u have received gifts 4 men; yeah, 4 tha rebellious also, dat tha LORD God might live among ’em.
Blessed be tha Lord, who daily loadeth us wit benefits, even tha God of our salvation. Selah.
He dat is our God is tha God of salvation; N 2 GOD tha Lord belong tha issues from death.
But God shall wound tha head of his opps, N tha hairy scalp of such an one as goes on still in his trespasses.
Tha Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from tha depths of tha sea:
Dat ur foot may be dipped in tha blood of thine opps, N tha tongue of ur dogs in tha same.
Dey have seen ur goings, O God; even tha goings of my God, my King, in tha sanctuary.
Tha singers went before, tha players on instruments followed after; among ’em were tha damsels playing wit timbrels.
Bless y’all God in tha congregations, even tha Lord, from tha fountain of Israel.
There is little Benjamin wit their ruler, tha princes of Judah N their council, tha princes of Zebulun, N tha princes of Naphtali.
Ur God has commanded ur strength: strengthen, O God, dat which u have wrought 4 us.
Because of ur temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents 2 u.
Rebuke tha company of spearmen, tha crowd of tha bulls, wit tha calves of tha people, till every one submit himself wit pieces of silver: scatter u tha people dat delight in war.
Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands 2 God.
Sing 2 God, y’all kingdoms of tha earth; O sing praises 2 tha Lord; Selah:
2 him dat rides upon tha heavenz of heavenz, which were of old; look, he does send out his voice, N dat a mighty voice.
Ascribe y’all strength 2 God: his excellency is over Israel, N his strength is in tha clouds.
O God, u r terrible out of ur holy places: tha God of Israel is he dat gives strength N power 2 his people. Blessed be God.

69.text: Save me, O God; 4 tha waterz r come in 2 my soul.
I sink in deep mire, where there is no standin: I am come in2 deep waterz, where tha floods overflow me.
I am weary of my cryin: my throat is dried: my eyes fail while I wait 4 my God.
Dey dat hate me without a cause r more than tha hairs of mine head: dey dat would destroy me, bein mine opps wrongfully, r mighty: then I restored dat which I took not away.
O God, u know my foolishness; N my sins r not hid from u.
Don’t let ’em dat wait on u, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed 4 my sake: don’t let dose dat seek u be confounded 4 my sake, O God of Israel.
Because 4 ur sake I have borne reproach; shame has covered my face.
I am become a stranger 2 my brothers, N an alien 2 my mother’s children.
4 tha zeal of thine house has eaten me up; N tha reproaches of ’em dat reproached u r fallen upon me.
When I wept, N chastened my soul wit fasting, dat was 2 my reproach.
I made sackcloth also my garment; N I became a proverb 2 ’em.
Dey dat sit in tha gate speak against me; N I was tha song of tha drunkards.
But as 4 me, my prayer is 2 u, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in tha crowd of ur mercy hear me, in tha truth of ur salvation.
Deliver me out of tha mire, N let me not sink: let me be delivered from ’em dat hate me, N out of tha deep waterz.
Don’t let tha waterflood overflow me, neither let tha deep swallow me up, N don’t let tha pit shut her mouth upon me.
Hear me, O LORD; 4 ur lovingkindness is good: turn 2 me according 2 tha crowd of ur tender mercies.
N hide not ur face from ur servant; 4 I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
Draw nigh 2 my soul, N redeem it: deliver me because of mine opps.
u have known my reproach, N my shame, N my dishonour: mine adversaries r all before u.
Reproach has broken my heart; N I am full of heaviness: N I looked 4 some 2 take pity, but there was none; N 4 comforters, but I found none.
Dey gave me also gall 4 my food; N in my thirst dey gave me vinegar 2 drink.
Let their table become a snare before ’em: N dat which should have been 4 their welfare, let it become a trap.
Let their eyes be darkened, dat dey see not; N make their loins continually 2 shake.
Pour out thine indignation upon ’em, N let ur wrathful anger take hold of ’em.
Let their habitation be desolate; N let none live in their tents.
4 dey persecute him whom u have struck; N dey talk 2 tha grief of dose whom u have wounded.
Add iniquity 2 their iniquity: N let ’em not come in2 ur righteousness.
Let ’em be blotted out of tha book of tha livin, N not be written wit tha righteous.
But I am poor N sorrowful: let ur salvation, O God, set me up on high.
I will praise tha name of God wit a song, N will magnify him wit thanksgiving.
Dis also shall please tha LORD better than an ox or bullock dat has horns N hoofs.
Tha humble shall see dis, N be glad: N ur heart shall live dat seek God.
4 tha LORD hears tha poor, N despiseth not his prisoners.
Let tha heaven N earth praise him, tha seas, N every thing dat moveth in it.
4 God will save Zion, N will build tha citiez of Judah: dat dey may live there, N have it in possession.
Tha seed also of his servants shall inherit it: N dey dat love his name shall live in it.

70.text: Make haste, O God, 2 deliver me; make haste 2 help me, O LORD.
Let ’em be ashamed N confounded dat seek after my soul: let ’em be turned backward, N put 2 confusion, dat desire my hurt.
Let ’em be turned back 4 a reward of their shame dat say, Aha, aha.
Let all dose dat seek u rejoice N be glad in u: N let such as love ur salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
But I am poor N needy: make haste 2 me, O God: u r my help N my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

71.text: In u, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put 2 confusion.
Deliver me in ur righteousness, N cause me 2 escape: incline thine ear 2 me, N save me.
Be u my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: u have given commandment 2 save me; 4 u r my rock N my fortress.
Deliver me, O my God, out of tha hand of tha wicked, out of tha hand of tha unrighteous N cruel man.
4 u r my hope, O Lord GOD: u r my trust from my youth.
By u have I been holden up from tha womb: u r he dat took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of u.
I am as a wonder 2 many; but u r my strong refuge.
Let my mouth be filled wit ur praise N wit ur honour all tha day.
Cast me not off in tha time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.
4 mine opps speak against me; N dey dat lay wait 4 my soul take counsel together,
Sayin, God has forsaken him: persecute N take him; 4 there is none 2 deliver him.
O God, don’t be far from me: O my God, make haste 4 my help.
Let ’em be confounded N consumed dat r adversaries 2 my soul; let ’em be covered wit reproach N dishonour dat seek my hurt.
But I will hope continually, N will yet praise u more N more.
My mouth shall show forth ur righteousness N ur salvation all tha day; 4 I know not tha numbers of it.
I will go in tha strength of tha Lord GOD: I will make mention of ur righteousness, even of thine only.
O God, u have taught me from my youth: N until now have I declared ur wondrous works.
Now also when I am old N grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have showed ur strength 2 dis generation, N ur power 2 every one dat is 2 come.
Ur righteousness also, O God, is very high, who have done great things: O God, who is like 2 u!
u, which have showed me great N sore troubles, will quicken me again, N will bring me up again from tha depths of tha earth.
u will increase my greatness, N comfort me on every side.
I will also praise u wit tha psaltery, even ur truth, O my God: 2 u will I sing wit tha harp, O u Holy One of Israel.
My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing 2 u; N my soul, which u have redeemed.
My tongue also shall talk of ur righteousness all tha day long: 4 dey r confounded, 4 dey r brought 2 shame, dat seek my hurt.

72.text: Give tha king ur judgments, O God, N ur righteousness 2 tha king’s son.
He shall judge ur people wit righteousness, N ur poor wit judgment.
Tha mountains shall bring peace 2 tha people, N tha little hills, by righteousness.
He shall judge tha poor of tha people, he shall save tha children of tha needy, N shall break in pieces tha oppressor.
Dey shall fear u as long as tha sun N moon endure, throughout all generations.
He shall come down like rain upon tha mown grass: as showers dat water tha earth.
In his days shall tha righteous flourish; N abundance of peace so long as tha moon endures.
He shall have dominion also from sea 2 sea, N from tha river 2 tha ends of tha earth.
Dey dat live in tha wilderness shall bow before him; N his opps shall lick tha dust.
Tha kings of Tarshish N of tha isles shall bring presents: tha kings of Sheba N Seba shall offer gifts.
Yeah, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
4 he shall deliver tha needy when he cries; tha poor also, N him dat has no helper.
He shall spare tha poor N needy, N shall save tha souls of tha needy.
He shall redeem their soul from deceit N violence: N precious shall their blood be in his sight.
N he shall live, N 2 him shall be given of tha gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made 4 him continually; N daily shall he be praised.
There shall be an handful of corn in tha earth upon tha top of tha mountains; tha fruit of it shall shake like Lebanon: N dey of tha city shall flourish like grass of tha earth.
His name shall endure 4 ever: his name shall be continued as long as tha sun: N men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
Blessed be tha LORD God, tha God of Israel, who only does wondrous things.
N blessed be his glorious name 4 ever: N let tha whole earth be filled wit his glory; Amen, N Amen.
Tha prayers of David tha son of Jesse r ended.

73.text: Truly God is good 2 Israel, even 2 such as r of a clean heart.
But as 4 me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
4 I was envious at tha foolish, when I saw tha prosperity of tha wicked.
4 there r no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
Dey r not in trouble as other men; neither r dey plagued like other men.
Therefore pride compasseth ’em about as a chain; violence covers ’em as a garment.
Their eyes stand out wit fatness: dey have more than heart could wish.
Dey r corrupt, N speak wickedly concerning oppression: dey speak loftily.
Dey set their mouth against tha heavenz, N their tongue walks through tha earth.
Therefore his people return here: N waterz of a full cup r wrung out 2 ’em.
N dey say, How does God know? N is there knowledge in tha most High?
Look, dese r tha ungodly, who prosper in tha world; dey increase in riches.
For real I have cleansed my heart in vain, N washed my hands in innocency.
4 all tha day long have I been plagued, N chastened every morning.
If I say, I will speak like dis; look, I should offend against tha generation of ur children.
When I thought 2 know dis, it was too painful 4 me;
Until I went in2 tha sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
Surely u did set ’em in slippery places: u castedst ’em down in2 destruction.
How r dey brought in2 desolation, as in a moment! dey r utterly consumed wit terrors.
As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when u awakest, u will despise their image.
Like dis my heart was grieved, N I was pricked in my reins.
So foolish was I, N ignorant: I was as a beast before u.
Nevertheless I am continually wit u: u have holden me by my right hand.
u will guide me wit ur counsel, N afterward receive me 2 glory.
Whom have I in heaven but u? N there is none upon earth dat I desire beside u.
My flesh N my heart fails: but God is tha strength of my heart, N my portion 4 ever.
4, look, dey dat r far from u shall perish: u have destroyed all ’em dat go a whoring from u.
But it is good 4 me 2 draw near 2 God: I have put my trust in tha Lord GOD, dat I may declare all ur works.

74.text: O God, why have u cast us off 4 ever? why does thine anger smoke against tha sheep of ur pasture?
Remember ur congregation, which u have purchased of old; tha rod of thine inheritance, which u have redeemed; dis mount Zion, in which u have lived.
Lift up ur feet 2 tha perpetual desolations; even all dat tha opp has done wickedly in tha sanctuary.
Thine opps roar in tha midst of ur congregations; dey set up their ensigns 4 signs.
A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon tha thick trees.
But now dey break down tha carved work of it at once wit axes N hammers.
Dey have cast fire in2 ur sanctuary, dey have defiled by castin down tha livin place of ur name 2 tha ground.
Dey said in their hearts, Let us destroy ’em together: dey have burned up all tha synagogues of God in tha land.
We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any dat knows how long.
O God, how long shall tha adversary reproach? shall tha opp blaspheme ur name 4 ever?
Why withdrawest u ur hand, even ur right hand? pluck it out of ur bosom.
4 God is my King of old, workin salvation in tha midst of tha earth.
u did divide tha sea by ur strength: u brakest tha heads of tha dragons in tha waterz.
u brakest tha heads of leviathan in pieces, N gave him 2 be food 2 tha people inhabiting tha wilderness.
u did cleave tha fountain N tha flood: u driedst up mighty rivers.
Tha day is thine, tha night also is thine: u have prepared tha light N tha sun.
u have set all tha borders of tha earth: u have made summer N winter.
Remember dis, dat tha opp has reproached, O LORD, N dat tha foolish people have blasphemed ur name.
O deliver not tha soul of ur turtledove 2 tha crowd of tha wicked: forget not tha congregation of ur poor 4 ever.
Have respect 2 tha covenant: 4 tha dark places of tha earth r full of tha habitations of cruelty.
O don’t let tha oppressed return ashamed: let tha poor N needy praise ur name.
Arise, O God, plead ur own cause: remember how tha foolish man reproaches u daily.
Forget not tha voice of thine opps: tha tumult of dose dat rise up against u increases continually.

75.text: 2 u, O God, do we give thanks, 2 u do we give thanks: 4 dat ur name is near ur wondrous works declare.
When I shall receive tha congregation I will judge uprightly.
Tha earth N all tha inhabitants of it r dissolved: I bear up tha pillars of it. Selah.
I said 2 tha fools, Deal not foolishly: N 2 tha wicked, Lift not up tha horn:
Lift not up ur horn on high: speak not wit a stiff neck.
4 promotion comes neither from tha east, nor from tha west, nor from tha south.
But God is tha judge: he puts down one, N sets up another.
4 in tha hand of tha LORD there is a cup, N tha wine is red; it is full of mixture; N he pours out of tha same: but tha dregs of it, all tha wicked of tha earth shall wring ’em out, N drink ’em.
But I will declare 4 ever; I will sing praises 2 tha God of Jacob.
All tha horns of tha wicked also will I cut off; but tha horns of tha righteous shall be exalted.

76.text: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
In Salem also is his tabernacle, N his livin place in Zion.
There broke he tha arrows of tha bow, tha shield, N tha sword, N tha battle. Selah.
u r more glorious N excellent than tha mountains of prey.
Tha stouthearted r spoiled, dey have slept their sleep: N none of tha men of might have found their hands.
At ur rebuke, O God of Jacob, both tha chariot N horse r cast in2 a dead sleep.
u, even u, art 2 be feared: N who may stand in ur sight when once u r angry?
u did cause judgment 2 be heard from heaven; tha earth feared, N was still,
When God arose 2 judgment, 2 save all tha meek of tha earth. Selah.
Surely tha wrath of man shall praise u: tha remainder of wrath will u restrain.
Vow, N pay 2 tha LORD ur God: let all dat be round about him bring presents 2 him dat ought 2 be feared.
He shall cut off tha spirit of princes: he is terrible 2 tha kings of tha earth.

77.text: I cried 2 God wit my voice, even 2 God wit my voice; N he gave ear 2 me.
In tha day of my trouble I sought tha Lord: my sore ran in tha night, N ceased not: my soul refused 2 be comforted.
I remembered God, N was troubled: I complained, N my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
u hold my eyes waking: I am so troubled dat I cannot speak.
I have considered tha days of old, tha years of ancient times.
I call 2 remembrance my song in tha night: I commune wit my own heart: N my spirit made diligent search.
Will tha Lord cast off 4 ever? N will he be favourable no more?
Is his mercy clean gone 4 ever? does his promise fail 4 evermore?
Has God forgotten 2 be gracious? has he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
N I said, dis is my infirmity: but I will remember tha years of tha right hand of tha most High.
I will remember tha works of tha LORD: surely I will remember ur wonders of old.
I will meditate also of all ur work, N talk of ur doings.
Ur way, O God, is in tha sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
u r tha God dat do wonders: u have declared ur strength among tha people.
u have wit thine arm redeemed ur people, tha sons of Jacob N Joseph. Selah.
Tha waterz saw u, O God, tha waterz saw u; dey were afraid: tha depths also were troubled.
Tha clouds poured out water: tha skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
Tha voice of ur thunder was in tha heaven: tha lightnings lightened tha world: tha earth trembled N shook.
Ur way is in tha sea, N ur path in tha great waterz, N ur footsteps r not known.
u leddest ur people like a flock by tha hand of Moses N Aaron.

78.text: Listen up, O my people, 2 my law: incline ur ears 2 tha words of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
Which we have heard N known, N our fathers have told us.
We will not hide ’em from their children, shewing 2 tha generation 2 come tha praises of tha LORD, N his strength, N his wonderful works dat he has done.
4 he established a testimony in Jacob, N appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, dat dey should make ’em known 2 their children:
Dat tha generation 2 come might know ’em, even tha children which should be born; who should arise N declare ’em 2 their children:
Dat dey might set their hope in God, N not forget tha works of God, but keep his commandments:
N might not be as their fathers, a stubborn N rebellious generation; a generation dat set not their heart aright, N whose spirit was not stedfast wit God.
Tha children of Ephraim, bein armed, N carryin bows, turned back in tha day of battle.
Dey kept not tha covenant of God, N refused 2 walk in his law;
N forgat his works, N his wonders dat he had showed ’em.
Marvellous things did he in tha sight of their fathers, in tha land of Egypt, in tha field of Zoan.
He divided tha sea, N caused ’em 2 pass through; N he made tha waterz 2 stand as an heap.
In tha daytime also he led ’em wit a cloud, N all tha night wit a light of fire.
He clave tha rocks in tha wilderness, N gave ’em drink as out of tha great depths.
He brought streams also out of tha rock, N caused waterz 2 run down like rivers.
N dey sinned yet more against him by provoking tha most High in tha wilderness.
N dey tempted God in their heart by asking food 4 their lust.
Yeah, dey spoke against God; dey said, Can God furnish a table in tha wilderness?
Look, he struck tha rock, dat tha waterz gushed out, N tha streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh 4 his people?
Therefore tha LORD heard dis, N was angry: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, N anger also came up against Israel;
Because dey believed not in God, N trusted not in his salvation:
Though he had commanded tha clouds from above, N opened tha doors of heaven,
N had rained down manna upon ’em 2 eat, N had given ’em of tha corn of heaven.
Man did eat angels’ food: he sent ’em food 2 tha full.

79.text: O God, tha heathen r come in2 thine inheritance; ur holy temple have dey defiled; dey have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

Tha LORD shall send tha rod of ur strength out of Zion: rule u in tha midst of thine opps.
