Tha LORD has sworn, N will not repent, u r a priest 4 ever after tha order of Melchizedek.
Tha Lord at ur right hand shall strike through kings in tha day of his wrath.
He shall judge among tha heathen, he shall fill tha places wit tha dead bodies; he shall wound tha heads over many countries.
He shall drink of tha brook in tha way: therefore shall he lift up tha head.

111.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. I will praise tha LORD wit my whole heart, in tha assembly of tha upright, N in tha congregation.
Tha works of tha LORD r great, sought out of all ’em dat have pleasure in it.
His work is honourable N glorious: N his righteousness endures 4 ever.
He has made his wonderful works 2 be remembered: tha LORD is gracious N full of compassion.
He has given food 2 ’em dat fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
He has showed his people tha power of his works, dat he may give ’em tha heritage of tha heathen.
Tha works of his hands r verity N judgment; all his commandments r sure.
Dey stand fast 4 ever N ever, N r done in truth N uprightness.
He sent redemption 2 his people: he has commanded his covenant 4 ever: holy N reverend is his name.
Tha fear of tha LORD is tha beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all dey dat do his commandments: his praise endures 4 ever.

112.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. Blessed is tha man dat fears tha LORD, dat delights greatly in his commandments.
His seed shall be mighty upon earth: tha generation of tha upright shall be blessed.
Wealth N riches shall be in his house: N his righteousness endures 4 ever.
2 tha upright there arises light in tha darkness: he is gracious, N full of compassion, N righteous.
A good man shows favour, N lendeth: he will guide his affairs wit discretion.
Surely he shall not be moved 4 ever: tha righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trustin in tha LORD.
His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his opps.
He has dispersed, he has given 2 tha poor; his righteousness endures 4 ever; his horn shall be exalted wit honour.
Tha wicked shall see it, N be grieved; he shall gnash wit his teeth, N melt away: tha desire of tha wicked shall perish.

113.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. Praise, O y’all servants of tha LORD, praise tha name of tha LORD.
Blessed be tha name of tha LORD from dis time forth N 4 evermore.
From tha risin of tha sun 2 tha goin down of tha same tha LORD’s name is 2 be praised.
Tha LORD is high above all nations, N his glory above tha heavenz.
Who is like 2 tha LORD our God, who lives on high,
Who humbles himself 2 look tha things dat r in heaven, N in tha earth!
He raises up tha poor out of tha dust, N lifts tha needy out of tha dunghill;
Dat he may set him wit princes, even wit tha princes of his people.
He makes tha barren woman 2 keep house, N 2 be a joyful mother of children. Praise y’all tha LORD.

114.text: When Israel went out of Egypt, tha house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
Judah was his sanctuary, N Israel his dominion.
Tha sea saw it, N fled: Jordan was driven back.
Tha mountains skipped like rams, N tha little hills like lambs.
What ailed u, O u sea, dat u fleddest? u Jordan, dat u were driven back?
y’all mountains, dat y’all skipped like rams; N y’all little hills, like lambs?
Tremble, u earth, at tha presence of tha Lord, at tha presence of tha God of Jacob;
Which turned tha rock in2 a standin water, tha flint in2 a fountain of waterz.

115.text: Not 2 us, O LORD, not 2 us, but 2 ur name give glory, 4 ur mercy, N 4 ur truth’s sake.
So should tha heathen say, Where is now their God?
But our God is in tha heavenz: he has done whatever he has pleased.
Their idols r silver N gold, tha work of men’s hands.
Dey have mouths, but dey speak not: eyes have dey, but dey see not:
Dey have ears, but dey hear not: noses have dey, but dey smell not:
Dey have hands, but dey handle not: feet have dey, but dey walk not: neither speak dey through their throat.
Dey dat make ’em r like 2 ’em; so is every one dat trusts in ’em.
O Israel, trust u in tha LORD: he is their help N their shield.
O house of Aaron, trust in tha LORD: he is their help N their shield.
y’all dat fear tha LORD, trust in tha LORD: he is their help N their shield.
Tha LORD has been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless tha house of Israel; he will bless tha house of Aaron.
He will bless ’em dat fear tha LORD, both small N great.
Tha LORD shall increase u more N more, u N ur children.
y’all r blessed of tha LORD which made heaven N earth.
Tha heaven, even tha heavenz, r tha LORD’s: but tha earth has he given 2 tha children of men.
Tha dead praise not tha LORD, neither any dat go down in2 silence.
But we will bless tha LORD from dis time forth N 4 evermore. Praise tha LORD.

116.text: I love tha LORD, because he has heard my voice N my supplications.
Because he has inclined his ear 2 me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
Tha sorrows of death compassed me, N tha pains of hell got hold upon me: I found trouble N sorrow.
Then called I upon tha name of tha LORD; O LORD, I beg u, deliver my soul.
Gracious is tha LORD, N righteous; yeah, our God is merciful.
Tha LORD preserves tha simple: I was brought low, N he helped me.
Return 2 ur rest, O my soul; 4 tha LORD has dealt bountifully wit u.
4 u have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, N my feet from fallin.
I will walk before tha LORD in tha land of tha livin.
I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
I said in my haste, All men r liars.
What shall I render 2 tha LORD 4 all his benefits toward me?
I will take tha cup of salvation, N call upon tha name of tha LORD.
I will pay my vows 2 tha LORD now in tha presence of all his people.
Precious in tha sight of tha LORD is tha death of his saints.
O LORD, truly I am ur servant; I am ur servant, N tha son of thine handmaid: u have loosed my bonds.
I will offer 2 u tha sacrifice of thanksgiving, N will call upon tha name of tha LORD.
I will pay my vows 2 tha LORD now in tha presence of all his people,
In tha courts of tha LORD’s house, in tha midst of u, O Jerusalem. Praise y’all tha LORD.

117.text: O praise tha LORD, all y’all nations: praise him, all y’all people.
4 his merciful kindness is great toward us: N tha truth of tha LORD endures 4 ever. Praise y’all tha LORD.

118.text: O give thanks 2 tha LORD; 4 he is good: because his mercy endures 4 ever.
Let Israel now say, dat his mercy endures 4 ever.
Let tha house of Aaron now say, dat his mercy endures 4 ever.
Let ’em now dat fear tha LORD say, dat his mercy endures 4 ever.
I called upon tha LORD in distress: tha LORD answered me, N set me in a large place.
Tha LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do 2 me?
Tha LORD takes my part wit ’em dat help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon ’em dat hate me.
It is better 2 trust in tha LORD than 2 put confidence in man.
It is better 2 trust in tha LORD than 2 put confidence in princes.
All nations compassed me about: but in tha name of tha LORD will I destroy ’em.
Dey compassed me about; yeah, dey compassed me about: but in tha name of tha LORD I will destroy ’em.
Dey compassed me about like bees; dey r quenched as tha fire of thorns: 4 in tha name of tha LORD I will destroy ’em.
u have thrust sore at me dat I might fall: but tha LORD helped me.
Tha LORD is my strength N song, N is become my salvation.
Tha voice of rejoicin N salvation is in tha tabernacles of tha righteous: tha right hand of tha LORD does valiantly.
Tha right hand of tha LORD is exalted: tha right hand of tha LORD does valiantly.
I shall not die, but live, N declare tha works of tha LORD.
Tha LORD has chastened me sore: but he has not given me over 2 death.
Open 2 me tha gates of righteousness: I will go in2 ’em, N I will praise tha LORD:
Dis gate of tha LORD, in2 which tha righteous shall enter.
I will praise u: 4 u have heard me, N art become my salvation.
Tha stone which tha builders refused is become tha head stone of tha corner.
Dis is tha LORD’s doin; it is marvellous in our eyes. …: Heb. from tha LORD
Dis is tha day which tha LORD has made; we will rejoice N be glad in it.
Save now, I beg u, O LORD: O LORD, I beg u, send now prosperity.
Blessed be he dat comes in tha name of tha LORD: we have blessed u out of tha house of tha LORD.
God is tha LORD, which has showed us light: bind tha sacrifice wit cords, even 2 tha horns of tha altar.
u r my God, N I will praise u: u r my God, I will exalt u.
O give thanks 2 tha LORD; 4 he is good: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.

119.text: Blessed r tha undefiled in tha way, who walk in tha law of tha LORD.
Blessed r dey dat keep his testimonies, N dat seek him wit tha whole heart.
Dey also do no iniquity: dey walk in his ways.
u have commanded us 2 keep ur precepts diligently.
O dat my ways were directed 2 keep ur statutes!
Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect 2 all ur commandments.
I will praise u wit uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned ur righteous judgments.
I will keep ur statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by takin heed thereto according 2 ur word.
Wit my whole heart have I sought u: O let me not wander from ur commandments.
Ur word have I hid in mine heart, dat I might not sin against u.
Blessed r u, O LORD: teach me ur statutes.
Wit my lips have I declared all tha judgments of ur mouth.
I have rejoiced in tha way of ur testimonies, as much as in all riches.
I will meditate in ur precepts, N have respect 2 ur ways.
I will delight myself in ur statutes: I will not forget ur word.
Deal bountifully wit ur servant, dat I may live, N keep ur word.
Open u my eyes, dat I may look wondrous things out of ur law.
I am a stranger in tha earth: hide not ur commandments from me.
My soul breaks 4 tha longing dat it has 2 ur judgments at all times.
u have rebuked tha proud dat r cursed, which do err from ur commandments.
Remove from me reproach N contempt; 4 I have kept ur testimonies.
Princes also did sit N speak against me: but ur servant did meditate in ur statutes.
Ur testimonies also r my delight N my counsellors.
My soul clings 2 tha dust: quicken u me according 2 ur word.
I have declared my ways, N u heard me: teach me ur statutes.
Make me 2 understand tha way of ur precepts: so shall I talk of ur wondrous works.
My soul melts 4 heaviness: strengthen u me according 2 ur word.
Remove from me tha way of lyin: N grant me ur law graciously.
I have chosen tha way of truth: ur judgments have I laid before me.
I have stuck 2 ur testimonies: O LORD, put me not 2 shame.
I will run tha way of ur commandments, when u will enlarge my heart.
Teach me, O LORD, tha way of ur statutes; N I shall keep it 2 tha end.
Give me understanding, N I shall keep ur law; yeah, I shall observe it wit my whole heart.
Make me 2 go in tha path of ur commandments; 4 in it do I delight.
Incline my heart 2 ur testimonies, N not 2 covetousness.
Turn away my eyes from beholding vanity; N quicken u me in ur way.
Stablish ur word 2 ur servant, who is devoted 2 ur fear.
Turn away my reproach which I fear: 4 ur judgments r good.
Look, I have longed after ur precepts: quicken me in ur righteousness.
Let ur mercies come also 2 me, O LORD, even ur salvation, according 2 ur word.
So shall I have wherewith 2 answer him dat reproaches me: 4 I trust in ur word.
N take not tha word of truth utterly out of my mouth; 4 I have hoped in ur judgments.
So shall I keep ur law continually 4 ever N ever.
N I will walk at liberty: 4 I seek ur precepts.
I will speak of ur testimonies also before kings, N will not be ashamed.
N I will delight myself in ur commandments, which I have loved.
My hands also will I lift up 2 ur commandments, which I have loved; N I will meditate in ur statutes.
Remember tha word 2 ur servant, upon which u have caused me 2 hope.
Dis is my comfort in my affliction: 4 ur word has quickened me.
Tha proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from ur law.
I remembered ur judgments of old, O LORD; N have comforted myself.
Horror has taken hold upon me because of tha wicked dat forsake ur law.
Ur statutes have been my songs in tha house of my pilgrimage.
I have remembered ur name, O LORD, in tha night, N have kept ur law.
Dis I had, because I kept ur precepts.
u r my portion, O LORD: I have said dat I would keep ur words.
I intreated ur favour wit my whole heart: be merciful 2 me according 2 ur word.
I thought on my ways, N turned my feet 2 ur testimonies.
I made haste, N delayed not 2 keep ur commandments.
Tha bands of tha wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten ur law.
At midnight I will rise 2 give thanks 2 u because of ur righteous judgments.
I am a companion of all ’em dat fear u, N of ’em dat keep ur precepts.
Tha earth, O LORD, is full of ur mercy: teach me ur statutes.
u have dealt well wit ur servant, O LORD, according 2 ur word.
Teach me good judgment N knowledge: 4 I have believed ur commandments.
Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept ur word.
u r good, N do good; teach me ur statutes.
Tha proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep ur precepts wit my whole heart.
Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in ur law.
It is good 4 me dat I have been afflicted; dat I might learn ur statutes.
Tha law of ur mouth is better 2 me than thousands of gold N silver.
Ur hands have made me N fashioned me: give me understanding, dat I may learn ur commandments.
Dey dat fear u will be glad when dey see me; because I have hoped in ur word.
I know, O LORD, dat ur judgments r right, N dat u in faithfulness have afflicted me.
Let, I pray u, ur merciful kindness be 4 my comfort, according 2 ur word 2 ur servant.
Let ur tender mercies come 2 me, dat I may live: 4 ur law is my delight.
Let tha proud be ashamed; 4 dey dealt perversely wit me without a cause: but I will meditate in ur precepts.
Let dose dat fear u turn 2 me, N dose dat have known ur testimonies.
Let my heart be sound in ur statutes; dat I don’t be ashamed.
My soul fainteth 4 ur salvation: but I hope in ur word.
My eyes fail 4 ur word, sayin, When will u comfort me?
4 I am become like a bottle in tha smoke; yet do I not forget ur statutes.
How many r tha days of ur servant? when will u execute judgment on ’em dat persecute me?
Tha proud have digged pits 4 me, which r not after ur law.
All ur commandments r faithful: dey persecute me wrongfully; help u me.
Dey had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not ur precepts.
Quicken me after ur lovingkindness; so shall I keep tha testimony of ur mouth.
4 ever, O LORD, ur word is settled in heaven.
Ur faithfulness is 2 all generations: u have established tha earth, N it abides.
Dey continue dis day according 2 thine ordinances: 4 all r ur servants.
Unless ur law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
I will never forget ur precepts: 4 wit ’em u have quickened me.
I am thine, save me; 4 I have sought ur precepts.
Tha wicked have waited 4 me 2 destroy me: but I will consider ur testimonies.
I have seen an end of all perfection: but ur commandment is exceeding broad.
O how love I ur law! it is my meditation all tha day.
u through ur commandments have made me wiser than mine opps: 4 dey r ever wit me.
I have more understanding than all my teachers: 4 ur testimonies r my meditation.
I understand more than tha ancients, because I keep ur precepts.
I have refrained my feet from every evil way, dat I might keep ur word.
I have not departed from ur judgments: 4 u have taught me.
How sweet r ur words 2 my taste! yeah, sweeter than honey 2 my mouth!
Through ur precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
Ur word is a lamp 2 my feet, N a light 2 my path.
I have sworn, N I will perform it, dat I will keep ur righteous judgments.
I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according 2 ur word.
Accept, I beg u, tha freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, N teach me ur judgments.
My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget ur law.
Tha wicked have laid a snare 4 me: yet I erred not from ur precepts.
Ur testimonies have I taken as an heritage 4 ever: 4 dey r tha rejoicin of my heart.
I have inclined mine heart 2 perform ur statutes alway, even 2 tha end.
I hate vain thoughts: but ur law do I love.
u r my hidin place N my shield: I hope in ur word.
Depart from me, y’all evildoers: 4 I will keep tha commandments of my God.
Uphold me according 2 ur word, dat I may live: N let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold u me up, N I shall be safe: N I will have respect 2 ur statutes continually.
u have trodden down all ’em dat err from ur statutes: 4 their deceit is falsehood.
u put away all tha wicked of tha earth like dross: therefore I love ur testimonies.
My flesh trembleth 4 fear of u; N I am afraid of ur judgments.
I have done judgment N justice: leave me not 2 mine oppressors.
Be surety 4 ur servant 4 good: don’t let tha proud oppress me.
My eyes fail 4 ur salvation, N 4 tha word of ur righteousness.
Deal wit ur servant according 2 ur mercy, N teach me ur statutes.
I am ur servant; give me understanding, dat I may know ur testimonies.
It is time 4 u, LORD, 2 work: 4 dey have made void ur law.
Therefore I love ur commandments above gold; yeah, above fine gold.
Therefore I esteem all ur precepts concerning all things 2 be right; N I hate every false way.
Ur testimonies r wonderful: therefore does my soul keep ’em.
Tha entrance of ur words gives light; it gives understanding 2 tha simple.
I opened my mouth, N panted: 4 I longed 4 ur commandments.
Look u upon me, N be merciful 2 me, as u use 2 do 2 dose dat love ur name.
Order my steps in ur word: N don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
Deliver me from tha oppression of man: so will I keep ur precepts.
Make ur face 2 shine upon ur servant; N teach me ur statutes.
Rivers of waterz run down my eyes, because dey keep not ur law.
Righteous r u, O LORD, N upright r ur judgments.
Ur testimonies dat u have commanded r righteous N very faithful.
My zeal has consumed me, because mine opps have forgotten ur words.
Ur word is very pure: therefore ur servant loves it.
I am small N despised: yet do not I forget ur precepts.
Ur righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, N ur law is tha truth.
Trouble N anguish have taken hold on me: yet ur commandments r my delights.
Tha righteousness of ur testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, N I shall live.
I cried wit my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep ur statutes.
I cried 2 u; save me, N I shall keep ur testimonies.
I prevented tha dawning of tha morning, N cried: I hoped in ur word.
My eyes prevent tha night watches, dat I might meditate in ur word.
Hear my voice according 2 ur lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according 2 ur judgment.
Dey draw nigh dat follow after mischief: dey r far from ur law.
u r near, O LORD; N all ur commandments r truth.
Concerning ur testimonies, I have known of old dat u have founded ’em 4 ever.
Consider mine affliction, N deliver me: 4 I do not forget ur law.
Plead my cause, N deliver me: quicken me according 2 ur word.
Salvation is far from tha wicked: 4 dey seek not ur statutes.
Great r ur tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according 2 ur judgments.
Many r my persecutors N mine opps; yet do I not decline from ur testimonies.
I beheld tha transgressors, N was grieved; because dey kept not ur word.
Consider how I love ur precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according 2 ur lovingkindness.
Ur word is true from tha beginning: N every one of ur righteous judgments endures 4 ever.
Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart stands in awe of ur word.
I rejoice at ur word, as one dat finds great spoil.
I hate N abhor lyin: but ur law do I love.
Seven times a day do I praise u because of ur righteous judgments.
Great peace have dey which love ur law: N nothing shall offend ’em.
LORD, I have hoped 4 ur salvation, N done ur commandments.
My soul has kept ur testimonies; N I love ’em exceedingly.
I have kept ur precepts N ur testimonies: 4 all my ways r before u.
Let my cry come near before u, O LORD: give me understanding according 2 ur word.
Let my supplication come before u: deliver me according 2 ur word.
My lips shall utter praise, when u have taught me ur statutes.
My tongue shall speak of ur word: 4 all ur commandments r righteousness.
Let thine hand help me; 4 I have chosen ur precepts.
I have longed 4 ur salvation, O LORD; N ur law is my delight.
Let my soul live, N it shall praise u; N let ur judgments help me.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek ur servant; 4 I do not forget ur commandments.

120.text: In my distress I cried 2 tha LORD, N he heard me.
Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lyin lips, N from a deceitful tongue.
What shall be given 2 u? or what shall be done 2 u, u false tongue?
Sharp arrows of tha mighty, wit coals of juniper.
Woe is me, dat I stay in Mesech, dat I live in tha tents of Kedar!
My soul has long lived wit him dat hates peace.
I am 4 peace: but when I speak, dey r 4 war.

121.text: I will lift up my eyes 2 tha hills, from from where comes my help.
My help comes from tha LORD, which made heaven N earth.
He will not suffer ur foot 2 be moved: he dat keeps u will not slumber.
Look, he dat keeps Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
Tha LORD is ur keeper: tha LORD is ur shade upon ur right hand.
Tha sun shall not strike u by day, nor tha moon by night.
Tha LORD shall preserve u from all evil: he shall preserve ur soul.
Tha LORD shall preserve ur goin out N ur comin in from dis time forth, N even 4 evermore.

122.text: I was glad when dey said 2 me, Let us go in2 tha house of tha LORD.
Our feet shall stand within ur gates, O Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is builded as a city dat is compact together:
Where tha tribes go up, tha tribes of tha LORD, 2 tha testimony of Israel, 2 give thanks 2 tha name of tha LORD.
4 there r set thrones of judgment, tha thrones of tha house of David.
Pray 4 tha peace of Jerusalem: dey shall prosper dat love u.
Peace be within ur walls, N prosperity within ur palaces.
4 my brothers N companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within u.
Because of tha house of tha LORD our God I will seek ur good.

123.text: 2 u lift I up my eyes, O u dat dwell in tha heavenz.
Look, as tha eyes of servants look 2 tha hand of their masters, N as tha eyes of a maiden 2 tha hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon tha LORD our God, until dat he have mercy upon us.
Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: 4 we r exceedingly filled wit contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled wit tha scorning of dose dat r at ease, N wit tha contempt of tha proud.

124.text: If it had not been tha LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
If it had not been tha LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
Then dey had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
Then tha waterz had overwhelmed us, tha stream had gone over our soul:
Then tha proud waterz had gone over our soul.
Blessed be tha LORD, who has not given us as a prey 2 their teeth.
Our soul is escaped as a bird out of tha snare of tha fowlers: tha snare is broken, N we r escaped.
Our help is in tha name of tha LORD, who made heaven N earth.

125.text: Dey dat trust in tha LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abides 4 ever.
As tha mountains r round about Jerusalem, so tha LORD is round about his people from from now on even 4 ever.
4 tha rod of tha wicked shall not rest upon tha lot of tha righteous; lest tha righteous put forth their hands 2 iniquity.
Do good, O LORD, 2 dose dat be good, N 2 ’em dat r upright in their hearts.
As 4 such as turn aside 2 their crooked ways, tha LORD shall lead ’em forth wit tha workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

126.text: When tha LORD turned again tha captivity of Zion, we were like ’em dat dream.
Then was our mouth filled wit laughter, N our tongue wit singin: then said dey among tha heathen, tha LORD has done great things 4 ’em.
Tha LORD has done great things 4 us; whereof we r glad.
Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as tha streams in tha south.
Dey dat sow in tears shall reap in joy.
He dat goes forth N weepeth, bearin precious seed, shall doubtless come again wit rejoicin, bringin his sheaves wit him.

127.text: Except tha LORD build tha house, dey labour in vain dat build it: except tha LORD keep tha city, tha watchman waketh but in vain.
It is vain 4 u 2 rise up early, 2 sit up late, 2 eat tha bread of sorrows: 4 so he gives his beloved sleep.
Look, children r an heritage of tha LORD: N tha fruit of tha womb is his reward.
As arrows r in tha hand of a mighty man; so r children of tha youth.
Happy is tha man dat has his quiver full of ’em: dey shall not be ashamed, but dey shall speak wit tha opps in tha gate.

128.text: Blessed is every one dat fears tha LORD; dat walks in his ways.
4 u will eat tha labour of thine hands: happy will u be, N it will be well wit u.
Ur wife shall be as a fruitful vine by tha sides of thine house: ur children like olive plants round about ur table.
Look, dat like dis shall tha man be blessed dat fears tha LORD.
Tha LORD shall bless u out of Zion: N u will see tha good of Jerusalem all tha days of ur life.
Yeah, u will see ur children’s children, N peace upon Israel.

129.text: Many a time have dey afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
Many a time have dey afflicted me from my youth: yet dey have not prevailed against me.
Tha plowers plowed upon my back: dey made long their furrows.
Tha LORD is righteous: he has cut asunder tha cords of tha wicked.
Let ’em all be confounded N turned back dat hate Zion.
Let ’em be as tha grass upon tha housetops, which withers afore it grows up:
Wherewith tha mower fills not his hand; nor he dat binds sheaves his bosom.
Neither do dey which go by say, tha blessing of tha LORD be upon u: we bless u in tha name of tha LORD.

130.text: Out of tha depths have I cried 2 u, O LORD.
Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive 2 tha voice of my supplications.
If u, LORD, should mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
But there is forgiveness wit u, dat u may be feared.
I wait 4 tha LORD, my soul does wait, N in his word do I hope.
My soul waits 4 tha Lord more than dey dat watch 4 tha morning: I say, more than dey dat watch 4 tha morning.
Let Israel hope in tha LORD: 4 wit tha LORD there is mercy, N wit him is plenteous redemption.
N he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

131.text: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high 4 me.
Surely I have behaved N quieted myself, as a child dat is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
Let Israel hope in tha LORD from from now on N 4 ever.

132.text: LORD, remember David, N all his afflictions:
How he sware 2 tha LORD, N vowed 2 tha mighty God of Jacob;
Surely I will not come in2 tha tabernacle of my house, nor go up in2 my bed;
I will not give sleep 2 my eyes, or slumber 2 mine eyelids,
Until I find out a place 4 tha LORD, an habitation 4 tha mighty God of Jacob.
Look, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in tha fields of tha wood.
We will go in2 his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
Arise, O LORD, in2 ur rest; u, N tha ark of ur strength.
Let ur priests be clothed wit righteousness; N let ur saints shout 4 joy.
4 ur servant David’s sake turn not away tha face of thine anointed.
Tha LORD has sworn in truth 2 David; he will not turn from it; Of tha fruit of ur body will I set upon ur throne.
If ur children will keep my covenant N my testimony dat I shall teach ’em, their children shall also sit upon ur throne 4 evermore.
4 tha LORD has chosen Zion; he has desired it 4 his habitation.
Dis is my rest 4 ever: here will I live; 4 I have desired it.
I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor wit bread.
I will also clothe her priests wit salvation: N her saints shall shout aloud 4 joy.
There will I make tha horn of David 2 bud: I have ordained a lamp 4 mine anointed.
His opps will I clothe wit shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

133.text: Look, how good N how pleasant it is 4 brothers 2 live together in unity!
It is like tha precious ointment upon tha head, dat ran down upon tha beard, even Aaron’s beard: dat went down 2 tha skirts of his garments;
As tha dew of Hermon, N as tha dew dat descended upon tha mountains of Zion: 4 there tha LORD commanded tha blessing, even life 4 evermore.

134.text: Look, bless y’all tha LORD, all y’all servants of tha LORD, which by night stand in tha house of tha LORD.
Lift up ur hands in tha sanctuary, N bless tha LORD.
Tha LORD dat made heaven N earth bless u out of Zion.

135.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. Praise y’all tha name of tha LORD; praise him, O y’all servants of tha LORD.
y’all dat stand in tha house of tha LORD, in tha courts of tha house of our God,
Praise tha LORD; 4 tha LORD is good: sing praises 2 his name; 4 it is pleasant.
4 tha LORD has chosen Jacob 2 himself, N Israel 4 his peculiar treasure.
4 I know dat tha LORD is great, N dat our Lord is above all gods.
Whatever tha LORD pleased, dat did he in heaven, N in earth, in tha seas, N all deep places.
He causes tha vapours 2 ascend from tha ends of tha earth; he makes lightnings 4 tha rain; he brings tha wind out of his treasuries.
Who struck tha firstborn of Egypt, both of man N beast.
Who sent tokens N wonders in2 tha midst of u, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, N upon all his servants.
Who struck great nations, N killed mighty kings;
Sihon king of tha Amorites, N Og king of Bashan, N all tha kingdoms of Canaan:
N gave their land 4 an heritage, an heritage 2 Israel his people.
Ur name, O LORD, endures 4 ever; N ur memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
4 tha LORD will judge his people, N he will repent himself concerning his servants.
Tha idols of tha heathen r silver N gold, tha work of men’s hands.
Dey have mouths, but dey speak not; eyes have dey, but dey see not;
Dey have ears, but dey hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
Dey dat make ’em r like 2 ’em: so is every one dat trusts in ’em.
Bless tha LORD, O house of Israel: bless tha LORD, O house of Aaron:
Bless tha LORD, O house of Levi: y’all dat fear tha LORD, bless tha LORD.
Blessed be tha LORD out of Zion, which lives at Jerusalem. Praise y’all tha LORD.

136.text: O give thanks 2 tha LORD; 4 he is good: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
O give thanks 2 tha God of gods: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
O give thanks 2 tha Lord of lords: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him who alone does great wonders: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him dat by wisdom made tha heavenz: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him dat stretched out tha earth above tha waterz: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him dat made great lights: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
Tha sun 2 rule by day: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
Tha moon N stars 2 rule by night: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him dat struck Egypt in their firstborn: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
N brought out Israel from among ’em: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
Wit a strong hand, N wit a stretched out arm: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him which divided tha Red sea in2 parts: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
N made Israel 2 pass through tha midst of it: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
But overthrew Pharaoh N his host in tha Red sea: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him which led his people through tha wilderness: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
2 him which struck great kings: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
N killed famous kings: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
Sihon king of tha Amorites: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
N Og tha king of Bashan: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
N gave their land 4 an heritage: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
Even an heritage 2 Israel his servant: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
Who remembered us in our low estate: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever:
N has redeemed us from our opps: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
Who gives food 2 all flesh: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
O give thanks 2 tha God of heaven: 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.

137.text: By tha rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yeah, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
We hanged our harps upon tha willows in tha midst of it.
4 there dey dat carried us away captive required of us a song; N dey dat wasted us required of us mirth, sayin, Sing us one of tha songs of Zion.
How shall we sing tha LORD’s song in a strange land?
If I forget u, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
If I do not remember u, let my tongue cleave 2 tha roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Remember, O LORD, tha children of Edom in tha day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even 2 tha foundation of it.
O daughter of Babylon, who art 2 be destroyed; happy shall he be, dat rewards u as u have served us.
Happy shall he be, dat takes N dasheth ur little ones against tha stones.

138.text: I will praise u wit my whole heart: before tha gods will I sing praise 2 u.
I will worship toward ur holy temple, N praise ur name 4 ur lovingkindness N 4 ur truth: 4 u have magnified ur word above all ur name.
In tha day when I cried u answeredst me, N strengthenedst me wit strength in my soul.
All tha kings of tha earth shall praise u, O LORD, when dey hear tha words of ur mouth.
Yeah, dey shall sing in tha ways of tha LORD: 4 great is tha glory of tha LORD.
Though tha LORD be high, yet has he respect 2 tha lowly: but tha proud he knows afar off.
Though I walk in tha midst of trouble, u will revive me: u will stretch forth thine hand against tha wrath of mine opps, N ur right hand shall save me.
Tha LORD will perfect dat which concerneth me: ur mercy, O LORD, endures 4 ever: forsake not tha works of ur own hands.

139.text: O LORD, u have searched me, N known me.
u know my downsitting N mine uprising, u understand my thought afar off.
u compassest my path N my lyin down, N art acquainted wit all my ways.
4 there is not a word in my tongue, but, look, O LORD, u know it altogether.
u have beset me behind N before, N laid thine hand upon me.
Such knowledge is too wonderful 4 me; it is high, I cannot attain 2 it.
Where shall I go from ur spirit? or where shall I flee from ur presence?
If I ascend up in2 heaven, u r there: if I make my bed in hell, look, u r there.
If I take tha wings of tha morning, N live in tha uttermost parts of tha sea;
Even there shall ur hand lead me, N ur right hand shall hold me.
If I say, Surely tha darkness shall cover me; even tha night shall be light about me.
Yeah, tha darkness hides not from u; but tha night shines as tha day: tha darkness N tha light r both alike 2 u.
4 u have possessed my reins: u have covered me in my mother’s womb.
I will praise u; 4 I am fearfully N wonderfully made: marvellous r ur works; N dat my soul knows right well.
My substance was not hid from u, when I was made in secret, N curiously wrought in tha lowest parts of tha earth.
Ur eyes did see my substance, yet bein unperfect; N in ur book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of ’em.
How precious also r ur thoughts 2 me, O God! how great is tha sum of ’em!
If I should count ’em, dey r more in number than tha sand: when I awake, I am still wit u.
Surely u will kill tha wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, y’all bloody men.
4 dey speak against u wickedly, N thine opps take ur name in vain.
Do not I hate ’em, O LORD, dat hate u? N am not I grieved wit dose dat rise up against u?
I hate ’em wit perfect hatred: I count ’em mine opps.
Search me, O God, N know my heart: try me, N know my thoughts:
N see if there be any wicked way in me, N lead me in tha way everlasting.

140.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from tha evil man: preserve me from tha violent man;
Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually r dey gathered together 4 war.
Dey have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.
Keep me, O LORD, from tha hands of tha wicked; preserve me from tha violent man; who have purposed 2 overthrow my goings.
Tha proud have hid a snare 4 me, N cords; dey have spread a net by tha wayside; dey have set gins 4 me. Selah.
I said 2 tha LORD, u r my God: hear tha voice of my supplications, O LORD.
O GOD tha Lord, tha strength of my salvation, u have covered my head in tha day of battle.
Grant not, O LORD, tha desires of tha wicked: further not his wicked device; lest dey exalt themselves. Selah.
As 4 tha head of dose dat compass me about, let tha mischief of their own lips cover ’em.
Let burnin coals fall upon ’em: let ’em be cast in2 tha fire; in2 deep pits, dat dey rise not up again.
Don’t let an evil speaker be established in tha earth: evil shall hunt tha violent man 2 overthrow him.
I know dat tha LORD will maintain tha cause of tha afflicted, N tha right of tha poor.
Surely tha righteous shall give thanks 2 ur name: tha upright shall live in ur presence.

141.text: LORD, I cry 2 u: make haste 2 me; listen up 2 my voice, when I cry 2 u.
Let my prayer be set forth before u as incense; N tha liftin up of my hands as tha evening sacrifice.
Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep tha door of my lips.
Incline not my heart 2 any evil thing, 2 practise wicked works wit men dat work iniquity: N let me not eat of their dainties.
Let tha righteous strike me; it shall be a kindness: N let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: 4 yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
When their judges r overthrown in stony places, dey shall hear my words; 4 dey r sweet.
Our bones r scattered at tha grave’s mouth, as when one cuts N clings wood upon tha earth.
But my eyes r 2 u, O GOD tha Lord: in u is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
Keep me from tha snares which dey have laid 4 me, N tha gins of tha workers of iniquity.
Let tha wicked fall in2 their own nets, whilst dat I withal escape.

142.text: I cried 2 tha LORD wit my voice; wit my voice 2 tha LORD did I make my supplication.
I poured out my complaint before him; I showed before him my trouble.
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then u knew my path. In tha way in which I walked have dey privily laid a snare 4 me.
I looked on my right hand, N beheld, but there was no man dat would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared 4 my soul.
I cried 2 u, O LORD: I said, u r my refuge N my portion in tha land of tha livin.
Attend 2 my cry; 4 I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; 4 dey r stronger than I.
Bring my soul out of prison, dat I may praise ur name: tha righteous shall compass me about; 4 u will deal bountifully wit me.

143.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, listen up 2 my supplications: in ur faithfulness answer me, N in ur righteousness.
N enter not in2 judgment wit ur servant: 4 in ur sight shall no man livin be justified.
4 tha opp has persecuted my soul; he has struck my life down 2 tha ground; he has made me 2 live in darkness, as dose dat have been long dead.
Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
I remember tha days of old; I meditate on all ur works; I muse on tha work of ur hands.
I stretch forth my hands 2 u: my soul thirsteth after u, as a thirsty land. Selah.
Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit fails: hide not ur face from me, lest I be like 2 ’em dat go down in2 tha pit.
Cause me 2 hear ur lovingkindness in tha morning; 4 in u do I trust: cause me 2 know tha way in which I should walk; 4 I lift up my soul 2 u.
Deliver me, O LORD, from mine opps: I flee 2 u 2 hide me.
Teach me 2 do ur will; 4 u r my God: ur spirit is good; lead me in2 tha land of uprightness.
Quicken me, O LORD, 4 ur name’s sake: 4 ur righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
N of ur mercy cut off mine opps, N destroy all ’em dat afflict my soul: 4 I am ur servant.

144.text: Blessed be tha LORD my strength, which teaches my hands 2 war, N my fingers 2 fight:
My goodness, N my fortress; my high tower, N my deliverer; my shield, N he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
LORD, what is man, dat u take knowledge of him! or tha son of man, dat u make account of him!
Man is like 2 vanity: his days r as a shadow dat passes away.
Bow ur heavenz, O LORD, N come down: touch tha mountains, N dey shall smoke.
Cast forth lightning, N scatter ’em: shoot out thine arrows, N destroy ’em.
Send thine hand from above; rid me, N deliver me out of great waterz, from tha hand of strange children;
Whose mouth speaks vanity, N their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
I will sing a new song 2 u, O God: upon a psaltery N an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises 2 u.
It is he dat gives salvation 2 kings: who delivers David his servant from tha hurtful sword.
Rid me, N deliver me from tha hand of strange children, whose mouth speaks vanity, N their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
Dat our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; dat our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after tha similitude of a palace:
Dat our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: dat our sheep may bring forth thousands N ten thousands in our streets:
Dat our oxen may be strong 2 labour; dat there be no breaking in, nor goin out; dat there be no complaining in our streets.
Happy is dat people, dat is in such a case: yeah, happy is dat people, whose God is tha LORD.

145.text: I will extol u, my God, O king; N I will bless ur name 4 ever N ever.
Every day will I bless u; N I will praise ur name 4 ever N ever.
Great is tha LORD, N greatly 2 be praised; N his greatness is unsearchable.
One generation shall praise ur works 2 another, N shall declare ur mighty acts.
I will speak of tha glorious honour of ur majesty, N of ur wondrous works.
N men shall speak of tha might of ur terrible acts: N I will declare ur greatness.
Dey shall abundantly utter tha memory of ur great goodness, N shall sing of ur righteousness.
Tha LORD is gracious, N full of compassion; slow 2 anger, N of great mercy.
Tha LORD is good 2 all: N his tender mercies r over all his works.
All ur works shall praise u, O LORD; N ur saints shall bless u.
Dey shall speak of tha glory of ur kingdom, N talk of ur power;
2 make known 2 tha sons of men his mighty acts, N tha glorious majesty of his kingdom.
Ur kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, N ur dominion endures throughout all generations.
Tha LORD upholdeth all dat fall, N raises up all dose dat be bowed down.
Tha eyes of all wait upon u; N u give ’em their food in due season.
u open thine hand, N satisfiest tha desire of every livin thing.
Tha LORD is righteous in all his ways, N holy in all his works.
Tha LORD is nigh 2 all ’em dat call upon him, 2 all dat call upon him in truth.
He will fulfil tha desire of ’em dat fear him: he also will hear their cry, N will save ’em.
Tha LORD preserves all ’em dat love him: but all tha wicked will he destroy.
My mouth shall speak tha praise of tha LORD: N let all flesh bless his holy name 4 ever N ever.

146.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. Praise tha LORD, O my soul.
While I live will I praise tha LORD: I will sing praises 2 my God while I have any bein.
Put not ur trust in princes, nor in tha son of man, in whom there is no help.
His breath goes forth, he returns 2 his earth; in dat very day his thoughts perish.
Happy is he dat has tha God of Jacob 4 his help, whose hope is in tha LORD his God:
Which made heaven, N earth, tha sea, N all dat in it is: which keeps truth 4 ever:
Which executes judgment 4 tha oppressed: which gives food 2 tha hungry. tha LORD looseth tha prisoners:
Tha LORD opens tha eyes of tha blind: tha LORD raises ’em dat r bowed down: tha LORD loves tha righteous:
Tha LORD preserves tha strangers; he relieveth tha fatherless N widow: but tha way of tha wicked he turns upside down.
Tha LORD shall reign 4 ever, even ur God, O Zion, 2 all generations. Praise y’all tha LORD.

147.text: Praise y’all tha LORD: 4 it is good 2 sing praises 2 our God; 4 it is pleasant; N praise is comely.
Tha LORD does build up Jerusalem: he gathers together tha outcasts of Israel.
He healeth tha broken in heart, N binds up their wounds.
He tells tha number of tha stars; he calls ’em all by their namez.
Great is our Lord, N of great power: his understanding is infinite.
Tha LORD lifts up tha meek: he casts tha wicked down 2 tha ground.
Sing 2 tha LORD wit thanksgiving; sing praise upon tha harp 2 our God:
Who covers tha heaven wit clouds, who prepareth rain 4 tha earth, who makes grass 2 grow upon tha mountains.
He gives 2 tha beast his food, N 2 tha young ravens which cry.
He delights not in tha strength of tha horse: he takes not pleasure in tha legs of a man.
Tha LORD takes pleasure in ’em dat fear him, in dose dat hope in his mercy.
Praise tha LORD, O Jerusalem; praise ur God, O Zion.
4 he has strengthened tha bars of ur gates; he has blessed ur children within u.
He makes peace in ur borders, N fills u wit tha finest of tha wheat.
He sends forth his commandment upon earth: his word runs very swiftly.
He gives snow like wool: he scatters tha hoarfrost like ashes.
He casts forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
He sends out his word, N melts ’em: he causes his wind 2 blow, N tha waterz flow.
He shows his word 2 Jacob, his statutes N his judgments 2 Israel.
He has not dealt so wit any nation: N as 4 his judgments, dey have not known ’em. Praise y’all tha LORD.

148.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. Praise y’all tha LORD from tha heavenz: praise him in tha heights.. Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc
Praise y’all him, all his angels: praise y’all him, all his hosts.
Praise y’all him, sun N moon: praise him, all y’all stars of light.
Praise him, y’all heavenz of heavenz, N y’all waterz dat be above tha heavenz.
Let ’em praise tha name of tha LORD: 4 he commanded, N dey were created.
He has also stablished ’em 4 ever N ever: he has made a decree which shall not pass.
Praise tha LORD from tha earth, y’all dragons, N all deeps:
Fire, N hail; snow, N vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
Mountains, N all hills; fruitful trees, N all cedars:
Beasts, N all cattle; creeping things, N flying fowl:
Kings of tha earth, N all people; princes, N all judges of tha earth:
Both young men, N maidens; old men, N children:
Let ’em praise tha name of tha LORD: 4 his name alone is excellent; his glory is above tha earth N heaven.
He also exalts tha horn of his people, tha praise of all his saints; even of tha children of Israel, a people near 2 him. Praise y’all tha LORD.

149.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. Sing 2 tha LORD a new song, N his praise in tha congregation of saints.
Let Israel rejoice in him dat made him: let tha children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Let ’em praise his name in tha dance: let ’em sing praises 2 him wit tha timbrel N harp.
4 tha LORD takes pleasure in his people: he will beautify tha meek wit salvation.
Let tha saints be joyful in glory: let ’em sing aloud upon their beds.
Let tha high praises of God be in their mouth, N a twoedged sword in their hand;
2 execute vengeance upon tha heathen, N punishments upon tha people;
2 bind their kings wit chains, N their nobles wit fetters of iron;
2 execute upon ’em tha judgment written: dis honour have all his saints. Praise y’all tha LORD.

150.text: Praise y’all tha LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in tha firmament of his power.
Praise him 4 his mighty acts: praise him according 2 his excellent greatness.
Praise him wit tha sound of tha trumpet: praise him wit tha psaltery N harp.
Praise him wit tha timbrel N dance: praise him wit stringed instruments N organs.
Praise him upon tha loud cymbals: praise him upon tha high sounding cymbals.
Let every thing dat has breath praise tha LORD. Praise y’all tha LORD.
